creators_remaining.description: Resolved audience still to be processed. This is what confirms the audience resolved (e.g. your uploaded/CRM-group creators). Populated right after the automation is started.

created_via.title: Created Via
created_via.description: Surface that created this automation. Always populated: rows with NULL/empty `created_via` (predating migration 020) surface as `portal`. Common values: `portal` | `api` | `api_direct` | `mcp` | `agent` | `slack` | `internal` | `campaign_tc_auto` (and other internal surfaces may appear — the set is not closed; unknown values are returned verbatim and remain filterable). **`api_direct`** marks a single-creator Target Collab automation created by `POST /public/v1/target-collabs` (the direct-invite convenience surface) — these are named `API direct invite — {handle}`. Filter the list by `created_via` / `exclude_created_via` to include or hide them.

message_type.title: Message Type
message_type.description: Step kind, e.g. initial_message / message / image / tc_card.

message_entry.title: Message Entry
message_entry.description: The step's message text (template; placeholders not substituted).

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: Product shown, for product-card / TC-card steps.

days_after_previous.title: Days After Previous
days_after_previous.description: Follow-up delay in days (follow-up steps only).

has_image.title: Has Image
has_image.description: True when the step attaches an image. The internal image URL / filename is intentionally not exposed.

AutomationMessageStep.title: AutomationMessageStep
AutomationMessageStep.description:
One step in an automation's message sequence / follow-up chain — the
customer-facing projection of a ``config.addons[]`` / ``FOLLOW_UP_STEPS[]``
entry. Internal image-hosting URLs / filenames / CDN handles and worker
ordering keys are stripped; an attached image is signalled by ``has_image``.

tc_invite_message.title: Tc Invite Message
tc_invite_message.description: config.TARGET_COLLAB_MESSAGE — TC invite template (TC types only)

message_sequence.title: Message Sequence
message_sequence.description: config.addons — ordered DM sequence; array order is send order

personalization.description: CORE-4857 AI personalization config, when the automation has it (DM types only). Null otherwise. Configure via POST /automations/dm; use POST /personalization/* to preview.

AutomationMessagesTemplateResponse.title: AutomationMessagesTemplateResponse
AutomationMessagesTemplateResponse.description:
Message templates configured on one automation (CORE-5593).

This is the *configured* copy — placeholders like ``{{creators username}}``
or ``{creator_name}`` are not substituted. For the exact per-creator text
that was actually sent, use ``GET /automations/{id}/sent-messages``.

creator_message.title: Creator Message
creator_message.description: The main DM / creator message body the automation sends (config.CREATOR_MESSAGE). Placeholders (e.g. {creator_name}) are NOT substituted — this is the template.

message_sequence.title: Message Sequence
message_sequence.description: Ordered initial-outreach steps (config.addons). Array order IS send order (text / image / product card / TC card).

personalization.title: Personalization
personalization.description: AI-personalization settings when the automation enabled it (projected config.PERSONALIZATION). Null for non-personalized DMs.

spark_code_form.title: Spark Code Form
spark_code_form.description: Spark-code form settings, for automations created through this API and in the portal alike. `recipient_criteria` is the portal's audience filter — null when the automation selects by CRM group, or when it was created through the API.

AutomationMessagingDetail.title: AutomationMessagingDetail
AutomationMessagingDetail.description:
The outreach message content the portal shows: the actual DM/creator
message text, the message-type selector, and the ordered send sequence.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the send engine personalizes this automation's DM.

fallback_message.title: Fallback Message
fallback_message.description: Sent verbatim (name/product blocks filled) to creators with too little signal to personalize.

word_counts.title: Word Counts
word_counts.description: Approximate per-AI-block word-count targets, e.g. {"content_discussion": 25, "product_discussion": 20}. Null uses the brevity default.

name_source.title: Name Source
name_source.description: Which name fills the creator-name token (CORE-7779): first_name (the shipping first name on the creator's last order) or display_name (their TikTok display name). Null on automations that never set it -- same as first_name.

AutomationPersonalizationConfig.title: AutomationPersonalizationConfig
AutomationPersonalizationConfig.description:
CORE-4857 — the AI-personalization config on a DM automation, read back.

Projected from ``config.PERSONALIZATION`` (the block the send engine reads).
Present only when personalization was configured — via the portal composer
or via ``POST /automations/dm`` with a ``personalization`` object. ``null``
on automations that don't use it. Product/offer strings are the fixed values
the brand approved; the Content/Product-Discussion blocks are AI-generated
per creator at send time and so aren't stored here.

AutomationProductDetail.title: AutomationProductDetail
AutomationProductDetail.description:
A product attached to a Target Collab / TC-cleanup automation.

Commission rates are WHOLE-NUMBER PERCENTS (e.g. ``20.0`` == 20%), exactly
as stored on the automation and shown in the portal — not 0–1 decimals.

automation_type.title: Automation Type
automation_type.description: One of: target_collab | dm | email | sample_request.

created_via.title: Created Via
created_via.description: Surface that created the automation. Always populated on response: rows with NULL or empty `created_via` (predating migration 020) are surfaced as `portal` since the portal was historically the only writer. Common values: portal | api | api_direct | mcp | agent | slack | internal | campaign_tc_auto (set is not closed — other internal surfaces may appear). `api_direct` marks single-creator invites created by `POST /public/v1/target-collabs`.

side_effects.title: Side Effects
side_effects.description: Backend side-effects, e.g. {'crm_group_created': '<uuid>'} on sample_request creates.

AutomationResourceV2.title: AutomationResourceV2
AutomationResourceV2.description:
Canonical write-endpoint response. Replaces the v1 AutomationResource
(which mirrored the legacy single-shape body). Now reflects the
four-type taxonomy — `automation_type` is the public-API type, not the
DB string. The DB string is in `_internal_type` for debugging only.

status.title: Status
status.description: Effective automation status: 'active', 'stopped', 'deleted', or the derived 'expired' — an 'active' boost whose boost_end_date has passed. Filter on 'expired' to exclude boosts that have ended.

min_shop_gmv.title: Min Shop Gmv
min_shop_gmv.description: Minimum creator GMV for this shop over the rolling 90 days, required for sample approval. Null means no Shop GMV gate.

skip_ai_content_creators.title: Skip Ai Content Creators
skip_ai_content_creators.description: Approve automations only: creators TikTok labels as posting AI-generated content stay in To Review instead of being approved.

schedule.description: Optional — sample_request can run continuously. If set, the automation only auto-approves/rejects during scheduled hours.

creators_to_exclude.description: Optional creator exclusion. Persists as `config.excluded_creators` (sibling of `sample_request_config`) using `{excluded_lists_ids, excluded_crm_groups_ids, excluded_creator_ids}` shape — matches reacher-web-react formDataTransformer.ts.

AutomationSampleRequestRequest.title: AutomationSampleRequestRequest
AutomationSampleRequestRequest.description:
Body for POST /automations/sample-request.

Maps to DB `automation_type='New Sample Request Processing'`. Backend
side-effect: a CRM group is created from `minimum_performance_criteria`
so creator membership stays dynamic. The created `crm_group_id` is
returned in the response for reference.

AutomationSchedule.title: AutomationSchedule
AutomationSchedule.description:
Per-day creator-outreach caps + run window. Stored into Automations.schedule
JSONB. Same shape as the existing portal payload — keeps the portal and
Public API agreeing on schema.

daily_caps.title: Daily Caps
daily_caps.description: Per-weekday max-creators-per-day cap. Only days the automation runs are present; a day absent here means it doesn't send that day. Keys are weekday names (Monday…Sunday).

start_time.title: Start Time
start_time.description: Daily send-window start time, 24-hour HH:MM (config.SCHEDULE startTime).

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Business-hours timezone for the send-window restriction (config.business_hours_timezone). Null when the restriction is OFF.

business_hours_start.title: Business Hours Start
business_hours_start.description: Custom business-hours window start, 24-hour HH:MM in `timezone` (config.business_hours_start). Null means the 9am–9pm default.

business_hours_end.title: Business Hours End
business_hours_end.description: Custom business-hours window end, 24-hour HH:MM in `timezone`, exclusive, the same day as the start (00:00 = midnight). Null means 9am–9pm.

scheduled_start_time.title: Scheduled Start Time
scheduled_start_time.description: Daily start time, 24-hour HH:MM in `scheduled_start_timezone` (config.scheduled_start_time, CORE-7900). The automation waits until this wall-clock time each day before its first send. Null when off.

scheduled_start_timezone.title: Scheduled Start Timezone
scheduled_start_timezone.description: IANA timezone for `scheduled_start_time`. Null when off.

AutomationScheduleDetail.title: AutomationScheduleDetail
AutomationScheduleDetail.description: The send schedule the portal's edit view shows.

message.title: Message
message.description: Explicit empty state when the automation has sent nothing at all

AutomationSentMessagesResponse.title: AutomationSentMessagesResponse
AutomationSentMessagesResponse.description:
Exact sent copy for one automation, grouped by creator (DM) and
invitation batch (TC), with the campaign link where one exists.

total_creators_reached.title: Total Creators Reached
total_creators_reached.description: Total creators reached across all automations

total_sample_requests.title: Total Sample Requests
total_sample_requests.description: Total sample requests across all automations

total_emails_sent.title: Total Emails Sent
total_emails_sent.description: Total emails sent across all email automations

total_email_open_rate.title: Total Email Open Rate
total_email_open_rate.description: Email open rate (%); null when no emails sent.

total_email_reply_rate.title: Total Email Reply Rate
total_email_reply_rate.description: Email reply rate (%); null when no emails sent.

by_type.title: By Type
by_type.description: Count of automations by type (includes 'Email' for email automations)

by_type_and_state.title: By Type And State
by_type_and_state.description: Count of automations by type and state (live/archived)

invitation_message.title: Invitation Message
invitation_message.description: The Target Collab card message shown to invited creators (config.TARGET_COLLAB_MESSAGE). Placeholders are NOT substituted.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: Requested content type for the collaboration.

offer_free_samples.title: Offer Free Samples
offer_free_samples.description: Whether the collab offers free samples.

auto_resolve_conflicts.title: Auto Resolve Conflicts
auto_resolve_conflicts.description: Conflicting-invite resolution policy shown on the portal's TC card (config.AUTO_RESOLVE_CONFLICTS). Either a named policy (e.g. MOVE_NOT_ACCEPTED) or the toggle state as "true" / "false".

support_contact_email.title: Support Contact Email
support_contact_email.description: Brand support-contact email shown ON the TC invitation card the creator receives (customer-provided; config.EMAIL). Not a Reacher service address.

support_contact_phone.title: Support Contact Phone
support_contact_phone.description: Brand support-contact phone shown on the TC card (config.PHONE_NUMBER).

invite_start_before_days.title: Invite Start Before Days
invite_start_before_days.description: TC-cleanup: re-target invites started more than N days ago (empty = no bound).

invite_expire_after_days.title: Invite Expire After Days
invite_expire_after_days.description: TC-cleanup: re-target invites expiring after N days (empty = no bound).

AutomationTargetCollabDetail.title: AutomationTargetCollabDetail
AutomationTargetCollabDetail.description:
Target Collab card configuration — present only for TC / TC-cleanup
automations (``None`` for DM / email / sample-request types).

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Initial-outreach addons — text, images, product cards, etc. ALL items in this list are sent immediately together when the automation engages a creator. Use `follow_ups` for delayed follow-up steps. Empty messages = invite-only TC.

follow_ups.title: Follow Ups
follow_ups.description: Delayed follow-up steps. Each step has `delay_days` after the prior step (or after the initial outreach for the first follow-up) and one or more addons that fire together. Use this to build a multi-touch sequence.

auto_resolve_conflicts.title: Auto Resolve Conflicts
auto_resolve_conflicts.description: How the runtime handles creators who already have a pending TC invite from another automation. SKIP_ALL leaves them untouched; MOVE_NOT_ACCEPTED (default — matches portal-created automations) re-targets creators whose prior invite was never accepted; MOVE_ALL re-targets regardless of prior invite state. Maps to `config.AUTO_RESOLVE_CONFLICTS`.

is_evergreen.title: Is Evergreen
is_evergreen.description: When true, the automation continuously re-evaluates its `creators_to_include.filters` and queues newly-qualifying creators on each run. Has no effect for `lists` mode (lists are static) or `crm_group` mode (CRM groups are inherently evergreen). Maps to top-level `Automations.is_evergreen` column.

business_hours_timezone.title: Business Hours Timezone
business_hours_timezone.description: When set, the runtime restricts initial-outreach delivery to the business-hours window in this IANA timezone (e.g. `America/Los_Angeles`): 9am–9pm, or `business_hours_start` – `business_hours_end` when those are set. Follow-up steps keep their own timing. Null disables the restriction — messages can fire at any time within the schedule's daily window. Distinct from `schedule.timezone`, which governs *when the automation evaluates its queue* (per CORE-3031).

business_hours_start.title: Business Hours Start
business_hours_start.description: Custom business-hours window start, 24-hour `HH:MM` in `business_hours_timezone`, inclusive. Set together with `business_hours_end`; omit both for 9am–9pm.

business_hours_end.title: Business Hours End
business_hours_end.description: Custom business-hours window end, 24-hour `HH:MM` in `business_hours_timezone`, exclusive. Must be after the start on the same day; `00:00` means midnight.

scheduled_start_time.title: Scheduled Start Time
scheduled_start_time.description: Daily start time, 24-hour `HH:MM`, in `scheduled_start_timezone` (CORE-7900). Each day the automation waits until this wall-clock time before its first send, then runs until its daily limit — best effort, within about an hour, subject to TikTok rate limits. Mutually exclusive with `business_hours_timezone`. Initial outreach only; follow-up steps keep their own timing. Not supported on AI-enabled, CRM-group, or spark_code DM automations.

AutomationTargetCollabRequest.title: AutomationTargetCollabRequest
AutomationTargetCollabRequest.description:
Body for POST /automations/target-collab.

Maps internally to DB `automation_type='Target Collab'`, with or without
`messages` — the portal's TC v4 wizard does the same, carrying the DM and
card as addons (CORE-8568).

The TC Cleanup variant has its own top-level type
(`AutomationTcCleanupRequest` → `POST /automations/tc-cleanup`)
rather than living here as a flag. Reasoning: cleanup is structurally
different — no messages / follow-ups, no custom invite name,
products-only — and surfacing it as a TC mode forced callers to
submit fields the runtime ignores. Per architecture review 2026-05-01.

creator_source_type.title: Creator Source Type
creator_source_type.description: Creator selection mode (config.creator_source_type): lists / filters / crmGroup.

crm_group_id.title: Crm Group Id
crm_group_id.description: Selected CRM group id, when in crmGroup mode.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Legacy attribute filters for dynamic selection (config.Filters).

ai_search_filters.title: Ai Search Filters
ai_search_filters.description: AI-search attribute filters, when the automation uses AI-only filters (config.ai_search_filters).

AutomationTargetingDetail.title: AutomationTargetingDetail
AutomationTargetingDetail.description:
Which creators the automation targets — the portal's 'creators to
include / exclude' selection.

products.title: Products
products.description: Products to re-invite the matching creators for. Cleanup uses the same TargetCollabProduct shape (product_id + commission rates) as a regular TC. Required — runtime needs at least one product to issue the re-invite.

invite_start_before_days.title: Invite Start Before Days
invite_start_before_days.description: Re-target only creators whose original TC invite was sent at least N days ago. Null = no lower bound on invite age. Persists as `config.INVITE_START_BEFORE_DAYS`.

invite_expire_after_days.title: Invite Expire After Days
invite_expire_after_days.description: Re-target only creators whose original TC invite expires within the next N days. Null = no upper bound on time-to-expiry. Persists as `config.INVITE_EXPIRE_AFTER_DAYS`.

AutomationTcCleanupRequest.title: AutomationTcCleanupRequest
AutomationTcCleanupRequest.description:
Body for POST /automations/tc-cleanup.

A utility automation that re-targets creators in this shop who
received a TC invite from a prior automation but didn't accept it.
The runtime walks unaccepted-invite state shop-wide and re-invites
matching creators with the products supplied here.

Conceptually closer to `sample_request` (auto-process based on
criteria) than to the proactive TC outreach types — no messages,
no follow-ups. Maps to DB `automation_type='TC Cleanup'`.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Replace the initial-outreach addon set. ALL items are sent immediately together when the automation engages a creator. Pass `[]` to clear messages (invite-only). Use `follow_ups` for delayed sequencing. Only valid for `target_collab` and `dm` automations.

follow_ups.title: Follow Ups
follow_ups.description: Replace the delayed follow-up sequence. Pass `[]` to clear. Only valid for `target_collab` and `dm` automations.

target_collab.description: Partial update for the TC-specific config. Send only the keys you want to change — supported sub-keys mirror `TargetCollabConfig`: `invitation_name`, `valid_until`, `message`, `products`, `content_type`, `sample_policy`, `support_contact`, `lock_receivers_profiles`. Unknown keys are rejected with 422 (extra='forbid'). The translator merges into the existing `config` blob and dual-writes to the legacy UPPERCASE root.

dm_config.description: Partial update for the DM-specific config. Currently supports `spark_code` only (other dm_config keys were removed 2026-05-01).

sample_request.description: Partial update for the sample-request config. Send only the keys you want to change — supported sub-keys mirror `SampleRequestPayload`: `action`, `rejection_reason`, `approval_message`, `rejection_message`, `message_images`, `products`, `minimum_performance_criteria`, `maximum_performance_criteria`, `max_criteria_match`, `min_criteria_match`, `skip_ai_content_creators`, `auto_approval_settings`, `target_list`. Unknown keys (top-level OR nested) are rejected with 422 (extra='forbid'). The translator routes both criteria blocks through the V2 prefix + percent-scale helper.

business_hours_timezone.title: Business Hours Timezone
business_hours_timezone.description: Set or change the business-hours send-window timezone (CORE-3031). Pass an IANA name to enable, or the empty string `""` to disable (which also clears a custom window). Only valid for `target_collab` and `dm` automations.

business_hours_start.title: Business Hours Start
business_hours_start.description: Custom business-hours window start, 24-hour `HH:MM`, inclusive. Either bound may be sent alone (the other is kept); the effective pair must be complete and needs a business-hours timezone. `""` for both restores 9am–9pm.

business_hours_end.title: Business Hours End
business_hours_end.description: Custom business-hours window end, 24-hour `HH:MM`, exclusive. Must be after the start on the same day; `00:00` means midnight.

scheduled_start_time.title: Scheduled Start Time
scheduled_start_time.description: Daily start time, 24-hour `HH:MM`, in `scheduled_start_timezone` (CORE-7900). Each day the automation waits until this wall-clock time before its first send, then runs until its daily limit — best effort, within about an hour, subject to TikTok rate limits. Mutually exclusive with `business_hours_timezone`. Initial outreach only; follow-up steps keep their own timing. Not supported on AI-enabled, CRM-group, or spark_code DM automations.

AutomationUpdateRequest.title: AutomationUpdateRequest
AutomationUpdateRequest.description:
PATCH /automations/{id} — partial update across all 4 types.

Cannot change type / lifecycle fields / system fields. The set of
legitimately mutable fields varies by type, but for v1 we accept the
union and let the route validate type-specific constraints.

AutomationUpdateRequestPublic.title: AutomationUpdateRequestPublic
AutomationUpdateRequestPublic.description:
``PUT /public/v1/gmv-max/automations/{id}`` — the portal's update body.

PATCH semantics: only fields the caller sets are persisted
(``model_dump(exclude_unset=True)`` in the route).

data.description: Stored automation snapshot. For sample requests, config.sample_request_config.minimum_performance_criteria.min_shop_gmv is the rolling 90-day shop-specific approval floor; null disables it.

side_effects.title: Side Effects
side_effects.description: Backend side-effects, e.g. {'crm_group_created': 'uuid-...'} for sample_request creates.

creators_reached.title: Creators Reached
creators_reached.description: Unique creators reached, deduped shop-wide — a TRUE COUNT(DISTINCT creator) over the whole window across the raw Messages + target_collabs event tables (deduped across automations, not summed per day). No rollup lag, so a fresh day returns the real count. Always ``<= creators_reached_sum_of_rows``; the gap is creators hit by more than one automation.

creators_reached_sum_of_rows.title: Creators Reached Sum Of Rows
creators_reached_sum_of_rows.description: Σ over EVERY automation active in the window of that automation's distinct creators reached — a shop-wide window total, NOT limited to the automations on the returned page and NOT deduped across automations. The non-deduped counterpart to and upper bound of ``creators_reached``; the difference is the cross-automation overlap.

tc_invites.title: Tc Invites
tc_invites.description: Shop-wide count of Target Collab invitation rows (status NEW_INVITATION) sent in the window, from raw target_collabs. Matches the portal's 'Target Collabs' column.

tc_invites_creator_count.title: Tc Invites Creator Count
tc_invites_creator_count.description: Unique creators across Target Collab NEW_INVITATION creator-list arrays, deduped shop-wide over the window (raw target_collabs, no lag). Matches the portal dashboard's 'Total Creators' sub-label under Target Collabs — the field customers comparing API to UI most commonly expect.

creators_messaged.title: Creators Messaged
creators_messaged.description: Unique creators DM'd (BOT_INITIAL_MESSAGE), deduped shop-wide over the window from raw Messages. No rollup lag.

tc_acceptance_rate.title: Tc Acceptance Rate
tc_acceptance_rate.description: Average TC acceptance rate across the daily rollups in the window (mean of daily rates, not creator-weighted). Mirrors the portal dashboard's computation.

coverage_through.title: Coverage Through
coverage_through.description: Last date (YYYY-MM-DD) present in the ClickHouse rollup within the window. Applies ONLY to the rollup-sourced fields (emails, samples, videos, spark codes, showcase / content counts, tc_acceptance_rate) — the raw reach fields (creators_reached, creators_messaged, tc_invites, tc_invites_creator_count) do not lag and ignore this. The rollup refreshes ~every 6h and excludes the current day, so when this is earlier than the requested end_date those rollup fields under-count for the days after it. None means no rollup day was available in the window.

AutomationsListAggregate.title: AutomationsListAggregate
AutomationsListAggregate.description:
Shop-wide windowed metric totals. SHOP-WIDE — NOT per-automation.
Populated only when ``start_date`` and/or ``end_date`` is supplied on the
request (the aggregate is window-scoped by design); ``None`` on unfiltered
calls.

Two sources (CORE-7587):

- The reach / TC-creator fields — ``creators_reached``,
  ``creators_reached_sum_of_rows``, ``creators_messaged``, ``tc_invites``,
  ``tc_invites_creator_count`` — are computed from the SAME raw event
  tables (``Messages`` + ``target_collabs``) the per-row values use, as a
  TRUE shop-wide ``COUNT(DISTINCT creator)`` over the whole window, deduped
  across automations. These do NOT lag: a fresh/just-elapsed day returns
  the real count, never a false 0, and ``creators_reached`` reconciles with
  the per-row values (it is ``<=`` their sum — see below). If the raw query
  fails (e.g. a statement timeout), these reach fields fall back to the
  lagging rollup values for that response.
- Every other field (emails, samples, videos, spark codes, showcase /
  content counts, ``tc_acceptance_rate``) has no raw equivalent and is
  still sourced from the ``analytics.agency_dashboard_table`` daily rollup,
  SUMmed across the window to match the portal's Outreach Metrics
  dashboard. That rollup LAGS (refreshes ~every 6h, excludes the current
  day) — read ``coverage_through`` to see the last covered day; when it is
  earlier than your ``end_date`` those rollup fields under-count.

Mapping to the portal's "Outreach Metrics" card columns:

- ``creators_reached`` → "Creators Reached"
- ``tc_invites`` → "Target Collabs"
- ``tc_invites_creator_count`` → "Total Creators" sub-label
  under Target Collabs

shops_queried.title: Shops Queried
shops_queried.description: Shop names included when querying multiple shops (x-shop-id: all or comma-separated).

aggregate.description: Shop-wide windowed metric totals — populated only when a date filter is supplied. The reach / TC-creator fields are true shop-wide distinct counts over the window from the same raw event tables the per-row values use (deduped across automations, no lag); the remaining fields come from the portal-matching agency rollup. See ``AutomationsListAggregate`` for which field is which.

excluded.title: Excluded
excluded.description: Present only when this endpoint hides automations that exist for the shop, so 'none shown' can be told apart from 'none exist'. ``pagination.total_count`` counts only rows THIS endpoint returns (live, non-email). Keys: ``archived`` (count hidden unless ``show_archived=true``); ``email`` (count of email automations — a separate table managed via POST /automations/email, no list read path yet); and a ``note``.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD). Scopes ACTIVITY, not creation: when supplied (alone or with ``end_date``) the row set is restricted to automations that sent outreach in the window (an initial DM or a Target Collab invite dated inside it), so a long-running automation created earlier still appears with its in-window throughput. ``creators_reached`` / ``skipped`` / ``total_creators`` likewise switch from LIFETIME materialized-view values to in-window DISTINCT counts against the raw event tables. ``created_at`` is used only for sorting.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD). When supplied (alone or with ``start_date``), see ``start_date`` for the activity-window and creator-metric semantics.

automation_type.title: Automation Type
automation_type.description: Filter by the raw `Automation.automation_type` value, matched EXACTLY (case-sensitive). These values are historical/unnormalized — known examples: `Target Collab`, `TC Cleanup`, `New Sample Request Processing`. Unknown values (including the lowercase `target_collab` / `tc_cleanup` forms) match nothing. `Email` also returns nothing — email automations live in a separate table with no list read path yet; see the `excluded` block and POST /automations/email.

status.title: Status
status.description: Filter by status. Accepts either the display status (`Completed` | `Stopped` | `Running` | …) or the raw internal status (`continue` | `failed` | `inactive` | …) that /automations/stats reports. Evergreen CRM-group automations display as `Completed` between cycles — read the `is_evergreen` field on each row to tell 'armed and waiting' from 'finished'.

show_archived.title: Show Archived
show_archived.description: Include archived automations (state=archived). Default false mirrors the portal; the `excluded` block reports how many archived rows are hidden while this is false.

created_via.title: Created Via
created_via.description: Include only automations created by these surfaces. Common values: `portal` | `api` | `api_direct` | `mcp` | `agent` | `slack` | `internal` | `campaign_tc_auto` (set is not closed). NULL/empty provenance matches `portal`. Values not present in the shop's automation data match nothing; future/internal values remain filterable when they appear in the data. Example: `["api_direct"]` returns only single-creator direct invites.

exclude_created_via.title: Exclude Created Via
exclude_created_via.description: Exclude automations created by these surfaces. Applied after `created_via`. Example: `["api_direct"]` hides the `API direct invite — {handle}` rows produced by `POST /public/v1/target-collabs` so the list shows only your managed automations.

AutomationsListRequest.title: AutomationsListRequest
AutomationsListRequest.description:
POST /automations/list request body.

When ``start_date`` and/or ``end_date`` is supplied:

1. The ``creators_reached``, ``skipped``, and ``total_creators``
   fields on every returned automation row are computed as
   DISTINCT creators reached/skipped WITHIN the requested window —
   not the lifetime aggregates that the unfiltered call returns.
2. The response includes a top-level ``aggregate`` object with
   shop-wide windowed totals sourced from
   ``analytics.agency_dashboard_table`` (ClickHouse) — the same daily rollup
   the portal Outreach Metrics dashboard reads. Use
   ``aggregate.creators_reached`` /
   ``aggregate.tc_invites_creator_count`` etc. when you want
   numbers that match the portal UI exactly; the per-row fields
   are scoped per-automation and their sums won't equal the
   dashboard headlines.

See CORE-4861 for the history of why the API and UI used to
disagree on these numbers.

BingoGoalTemplate.title: BingoGoalTemplate
BingoGoalTemplate.description:
The goals a card square can carry.

Every one resolves to a metric already tracked, so a square is verifiable
without anyone ticking it by hand.

BingoPricing.title: BingoPricing
BingoPricing.description: A card of goals, paid per completed line. See RacePricing for extra=forbid.

BingoSquare.title: BingoSquare
BingoSquare.description:
One goal on the card.

``extra="forbid"``: the card round-trips through JSONB and back into a
per-creator rewards snapshot, so an unknown key must not smuggle through.

creators.title: Creators
creators.description: Creator handles. A leading `@` and surrounding whitespace are stripped and the handle is lowercased before storage. URLs are rejected. Duplicates within the request and handles already on the list are skipped, not errors.

BlacklistAddRequest.title: BlacklistAddRequest
BlacklistAddRequest.description: Creators to add to the shop's do-not-contact list.

duplicates_skipped.title: Duplicates Skipped
duplicates_skipped.description: Handles already on the list, left untouched.

BlacklistAddResponse.title: BlacklistAddResponse
BlacklistAddResponse.description: Outcome of an add — partial success is normal, not an error.

creators.title: Creators
creators.description: Blacklisted handles, most recently added first.

id.title: Id
id.description: Row ID, stable for this shop.

added_at.title: Added At
added_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the handle was blacklisted.

BlacklistedCreator.title: BlacklistedCreator
BlacklistedCreator.description: One row of the do-not-contact list.

BrandProfile.title: BrandProfile
BrandProfile.description: The analysed brand profile stored for the shop.

BriefProductSummary.title: BriefProductSummary
BriefProductSummary.description:
Compact catalog identity for the index-card poster thumbnails.

Deliberately NOT a ``ProductRef``: no per-product insight reads
(description/topHooks/brandVoice are generation context the cards never
render), so a list page resolves in one batched catalog query (CORE-6712).

BulkExclusionPreviewRequest.title: BulkExclusionPreviewRequest
BulkExclusionPreviewRequest.description: Dry run: what would an uploaded file change?

entity_id.title: Entity Id
entity_id.description: Product id or video id, per `ranking_type`.

creator_name.title: Creator Name
creator_name.description: Public TikTok handle, on video rankings.

new_customers.title: New Customers
new_customers.description: Buyers whose first purchase from this shop came through this entity.

customer_contribution.title: Customer Contribution
customer_contribution.description: This entity's share of the shop's new customers (0-1).

period_months.title: Period Months
period_months.description: Trailing window TikTok ranked over (typically 12 months).

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. REQUIRED for challenge / leaderboard / live_gmv_challenge campaigns (the portal launch form requires an end date for these); optional only for retainer campaigns, which may run open-ended.

description.title: Description
description.description:
REQUIRED for launch. Rich-text (HTML) campaign description shown to creators. Must contain visible text — an empty string or HTML-only value like '

' is rejected, matching the portal launch form.

products.description: REQUIRED for launch. The portal launch form needs at least one product: send products.all_selected=true to include every shop product, or products.items=[...] with 1-10 products.

creators.title: Creators
creators.description: Optional list of creators to seed into the campaign. Mirrors the portal's contract exactly (see `community.schemas.campaign.CampaignCreate.creators`) so the public API doesn't fork from `/api/marketplace/v2`. Each dict is opaque to validation but is typically `{"creator_id": int, "tier": str | None, "payout_override": int | None}`. Pass `null` or omit for the common case of "no seeded creators" (production fixtures all do this; creators are added later via the accept/reject flow).

window_url.title: Window Url
window_url.description: HTTPS URL — public landing/preview page for this campaign.

visibility.description: Who can DISCOVER this campaign. `public` lists it in Discover for every creator on Reacher; `shop_creators` lists it only for creators already connected to this shop; `invite_link` (the default) lists it nowhere. Listing only — the invite link keeps working on every tier and apply rules are identical. Defaults to `invite_link` so an integration that omits the field never publishes a campaign by accident. A campaign can only become `public` or `shop_creators` once it has a description, a reward and at least one product (products are not required for `live_gmv_challenge`); otherwise the write is rejected 422 with the missing keys.

exclusive_participation.title: Exclusive Participation
exclusive_participation.description: While on, a creator active in another overlapping campaign of this shop cannot be activated here (and vice versa).

creator_level.title: Creator Level
creator_level.description: Creator tier filter (list or CSV string).

short_header_message.title: Short Header Message
short_header_message.description: REQUIRED for launch. Short headline shown on the campaign card. Must be a non-empty string — the portal launch form rejects a blank value.

inspiration_links.title: Inspiration Links
inspiration_links.description: List of HTTPS URLs (inspiration videos, mood-boards, etc.).

CampaignCreateRequest.title: CampaignCreateRequest
CampaignCreateRequest.description:
``POST /public/v1/campaigns`` — create a campaign.

Mirrors ``community.schemas.campaign.CampaignCreateRequest`` minus
``shop_id`` (injected from the ``x-shop-id`` header).

Image fields here are URL strings only — the portal accepts
multipart file uploads, but public-API agents already have URLs
(uploaded via their own CDN or the portal). HTTPS-only enforced.

invite_link.title: Invite Link
invite_link.description: Public invite URL the caller can share with creators to join this campaign. Subdomain is picked by ``creator_source``: ``social_army`` campaigns (legacy partnership) use ``https://soco.reacherapp.com``; every other source — ``my_community`` and the rest — uses ``https://creator.reacherapp.com``. Full pattern: ``{base}/campaigns/{shop_id}/{uuid_id}``. Always populated on a successful 201. Falsy only in the unexpected case where the service returned without setting ``uuid_id``. Available on every campaign endpoint that returns a campaign payload: ``POST /campaigns``, ``GET /campaigns``, ``GET /campaigns/{id}``, ``GET /campaigns/{id}/detail`` — uniform contract.

tiktok_handle.title: Tiktok Handle
tiktok_handle.description: The TikTok handle this creator posts as for the campaign — the one they chose when enrolling, or their primary handle if they made no per-campaign choice. DB: creator_tiktok_auth.tiktok_username.

discord_handle.title: Discord Handle
discord_handle.description: Creator's linked Discord username. Creator-provided and optional — null when the creator has not connected Discord (only returned when with_discord_only=false). DB: creator_discord_links.username.

discord_user_id.title: Discord User Id
discord_user_id.description: Discord's stable numeric user id (snowflake) for the creator. Unlike the handle it never changes, so it is the reliable key for matching a Discord server member to this creator. DB: creator_discord_links.discord_user_id.

campaign_id.title: Campaign Id
campaign_id.description: Campaign the creator is linked to. DB: campaign_creator_mapping.campaign_id.

CampaignCreatorDiscordItem.title: CampaignCreatorDiscordItem
CampaignCreatorDiscordItem.description:
One campaign-linked creator's TikTok + Discord handles.

Grain is (campaign, creator): a creator working with several of your
campaigns appears once per campaign. Deliberately excludes the creator's
internal id, email, phone, address, avatar and Stripe state — the same
public-API privacy projection every other creator surface uses.

CampaignCreatorDiscordResponse.title: CampaignCreatorDiscordResponse
CampaignCreatorDiscordResponse.description: Paginated list of campaign-linked creators with Discord handles.

CampaignEmailTemplates.title: CampaignEmailTemplates
CampaignEmailTemplates.description: Email template configuration for a campaign.

metric_type.title: Metric Type
metric_type.description: Ranking metric for single-metric campaigns; the composite's tie-break/display metric for weighted.

weighted_metrics.title: Weighted Metrics
weighted_metrics.description: Metric/weight pairs (summing to 100) for weighted campaigns; null for single-metric.

total_creators.title: Total Creators
total_creators.description: Full participant count (active + Paid/Settled), independent of pagination.

standings_frozen.title: Standings Frozen
standings_frozen.description: True once the board is locked. Standings then stop changing: every metric and rank comes from the locked snapshot.

standings_frozen_at.title: Standings Frozen At
standings_frozen_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the board locked. Null while live.

standings_frozen_reason.title: Standings Frozen Reason
standings_frozen_reason.description: What locked it: `end_lag` (2 days after the close, the affiliate-sync lag), `first_payout`, `stop_close` (a stop condition tripped), `exclusion` (re-locked after a video exclusion), `manual_backfill`, or `legacy`. Null while live.

standings_period_end.title: Standings Period End
standings_period_end.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD, shop-local) the board counts sales for: the earlier of `end_date` and a stop-condition trip. Sales after it never reach the standings. Null for an open-ended campaign that is still running.

values_windowed.title: Values Windowed
values_windowed.description: True when `gmv`, `views`, `units_sold` and `videos_posted` are bounded to the campaign period (the normal case). False only while the daily ledger is unreachable: the board then shows lifetime values, which equal the windowed ones for a running campaign and overstate a campaign closed within the last two days. A locked board is never served unwindowed.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the standings were computed. On a locked board the values have not changed since `standings_frozen_at`.

CampaignLeaderboardResponse.title: CampaignLeaderboardResponse
CampaignLeaderboardResponse.description:
200 response for ``GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}/leaderboard``.

Ranked standings for a leaderboard (contest) campaign plus, when one is
active/recently-ended, the nested micro-challenge board. ``standings``
is paginated; ``total_creators`` is the full participant count. Scores
are computed by the same shared scorer the brand dashboard and public
share page use, so ranks agree across every surface.

all_selected.title: All Selected
all_selected.description: Whether all shop products are selected

use_first_product_image.title: Use First Product Image
use_first_product_image.description: Use first product image as campaign image

CampaignStatus.title: CampaignStatus
CampaignStatus.description:
DB-level campaign status. The frontend filter param 'active'/'past'
are UI aliases — 'active' maps to published, 'past' maps to != published.

creators.title: Creators
creators.description: Optional list of creators to seed into the campaign. Mirrors the portal's contract exactly (see `community.schemas.campaign.CampaignCreate.creators`) so the public API doesn't fork from `/api/marketplace/v2`. Each dict is opaque to validation but is typically `{"creator_id": int, "tier": str | None, "payout_override": int | None}`. Pass `null` or omit for the common case of "no seeded creators" (production fixtures all do this; creators are added later via the accept/reject flow).

visibility.description: Change who can discover this campaign. Omit to leave it as it is. See `POST /campaigns`. `listed_at` is stamped by the server on the transition into `public`/`shop_creators` and is never accepted from a client.

apply_to_existing_creators.title: Apply To Existing Creators
apply_to_existing_creators.description: Whether a payout-affecting edit re-stamps the reward snapshots of creators who already joined. Only retainer offers the choice: omitted, it applies to future joiners only. Every other type shares one prize table and always propagates, so false is refused (400). Paid or settled participants are never modified, and neither is a retainer participant on a renegotiated Request-More deal.

CampaignUpdateRequest.title: CampaignUpdateRequest
CampaignUpdateRequest.description:
``PATCH /public/v1/campaigns/{campaign_id}``.

Mirrors ``community.schemas.campaign.CampaignUpdateRequest`` minus
``shop_id`` and ``campaign_id`` (both injected — shop from header,
campaign from path).

``campaign_type`` and ``creator_source`` are immutable post-create
and are intentionally not in this shape; the portal rejects them
too.

participant_sync.description: Present when the edit touched payout-affecting pricing fields; absent otherwise.

CampaignVisibility.title: CampaignVisibility
CampaignVisibility.description:
Who can DISCOVER a campaign. Listing only: invite/join links and outreach
tokens resolve on every tier, and unlisting touches no mapping or payout.

shop_id.title: Shop Id
shop_id.description: Reacher shop id that owns this product (useful for multi-shop syncs).

category_chain.title: Category Chain
category_chain.description: Category hierarchy as stored by TikTok (leaf-last).

image_urls.title: Image Urls
image_urls.description: All image URLs for the product (empty when none are set).

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for the *_cents fields.

price_min_cents.title: Price Min Cents
price_min_cents.description: Lowest listed price across SKUs, in cents.

price_max_cents.title: Price Max Cents
price_max_cents.description: Highest listed price across SKUs, in cents.

out_of_stock_sku_count.title: Out Of Stock Sku Count
out_of_stock_sku_count.description: How many SKUs currently have zero stock.

product_status.title: Product Status
product_status.description: ACTIVATE / DRAFT / REVIEWING / etc. Null for unofficial shops.

affiliate_status.title: Affiliate Status
affiliate_status.description: TikTok affiliate eligibility (1=ELIGIBLE, 2/6=OUT_OF_STOCK, 3/999=UNAVAILABLE, 4=PLATFORM_DEACTIVATED). Refreshed every sync.

tiktok_created_at.title: Tiktok Created At
tiktok_created_at.description: When TikTok created the listing (ISO 8601 UTC).

tiktok_updated_at.title: Tiktok Updated At
tiktok_updated_at.description: When TikTok last changed the listing (ISO 8601 UTC).

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When Reacher last synced this product row (ISO 8601 UTC, microsecond precision). Feed the max value from a batch back as the next request's `updated_since` to drive a best-effort incremental sync. The filter is inclusive (`>=`), so re-fetch the boundary and de-dupe by `product_id`. Deleted products are not returned as tombstones, and a SKU-only change only appears if the sync also advanced this `updated_at` — a full mirror must reconcile deletions out-of-band.

skus.title: Skus
skus.description: Per-SKU rows with stock. Empty when include_skus=false.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Current stock for this SKU. This can differ from the product-level total_inventory while a catalog sync is in progress, so do not assume the two always agree.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Variant dimensions (color/size/etc.) that identify this SKU.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When Reacher last synced this SKU row (ISO 8601 UTC).

value_id.title: Value Id
value_id.description: TikTok value id for the selected value.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: Variant swatch image for this attribute value.

CatalogSkuVariant.title: CatalogSkuVariant
CatalogSkuVariant.description:
One sales attribute (variant dimension) of a SKU, e.g. color or size.

Passed through from product_catalog_sku.sales_attributes with the source
keys preserved so a CRM can match variants deterministically.

minimum_gmv_required_enabled.title: Minimum Gmv Required Enabled
minimum_gmv_required_enabled.description: Whether the minimum GMV floor is active

minimum_views_required.title: Minimum Views Required
minimum_views_required.description: Minimum views floor (when metric is views)

ranking_priority.title: Ranking Priority
ranking_priority.description: Primary ranking metric for gmv_videos contests; the other is a per-tier requirement

ChannelBaseline.title: ChannelBaseline
ChannelBaseline.description: TikTok's previous-period values, summed across the window.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: The day this benchmark was collected.

ChannelIndustryMedian.title: ChannelIndustryMedian
ChannelIndustryMedian.description: The typical seller in this shop's industry, as of one day.

attributed.title: Attributed
attributed.description: Cohort members traced to an automation.

unattributed.title: Unattributed
unattributed.description: Cohort members with no automation touch on record — organic, or reached before the 13-month outreach horizon. Reported rather than hidden: a near-total value means the join drifted, not that the shop ran no automations.

CohortAttributionResponse.title: CohortAttributionResponse
CohortAttributionResponse.description: Which outreach sourced a cohort, under a first-touch rule.

creators_sourced.title: Creators Sourced
creators_sourced.description: Cohort members first touched by this automation.

share.title: Share
share.description: creators_sourced as a share of the cohort (0-100).

CohortAttributionRow.title: CohortAttributionRow
CohortAttributionRow.description: One automation that sourced part of a cohort (CORE-6003).

posted.title: Posted
posted.description: Distinct creators who posted ≥1 video in this offset month.

gmv_count.title: Gmv Count
gmv_count.description: Distinct creators who drove GMV in this offset month.

total_videos.title: Total Videos
total_videos.description: Total videos posted by the cohort in this offset month.

CohortCell.title: CohortCell
CohortCell.description:
One grid cell: the raw counts behind cohort × month-offset.

Only the lower-left "triangle" is emitted — a cohort that started ``k``
months ago has offsets ``0..k`` and no future cells.

CohortCreator.title: CohortCreator
CohortCreator.description: One creator behind a clicked cell (drill-down).

capped.title: Capped
capped.description: True when the result hit the row cap and was truncated.

cap.title: Cap
cap.description: Max rows returned; results truncated beyond this.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Which half of the cell this list is: 'active' (creators who qualified at that offset) or 'lapsed' (cohort members who did not). Echoed back so the FE cannot mislabel the list.

CohortCreatorsResponse.title: CohortCreatorsResponse
CohortCreatorsResponse.description: Creators behind a single clicked cell (cohort × offset × metric).

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: Product filter, or null for the all-products grid.

computed_date.title: Computed Date
computed_date.description: Snapshot date for the default (no-product) grid; null for the live product-filtered path.

CohortGridResponse.title: CohortGridResponse
CohortGridResponse.description: Full cohort grid for one shop (optionally re-anchored to one product).

CohortRow.title: CohortRow
CohortRow.description: One cohort (creators grouped by month of first video) and its cells.

ConditionMetric.title: ConditionMetric
ConditionMetric.description:
Metric a condition evaluates. The trailing four (``roi``, ``spend``,
``ctr``, ``spend_pacing``) are ``/templates`` vocabulary the boost engine
cannot evaluate: a creative boost automation using one gets 422
``UNENFORCEABLE_RULE``.

ConditionOperator.title: ConditionOperator
ConditionOperator.description:
Comparison operator. The boost engine evaluates the short form (``lt``, ``lte``, ``gt``, ``gte``)
on every rule; the symbol form (``>=``, ``<``, ...) is ``/templates`` vocabulary and is refused
with 422 ``UNENFORCEABLE_RULE``.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: Metric to evaluate. Creative Boost evaluates (metric (operators)): 2s_video_view_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); boost_revenue (gt/gte/lt/lte); boost_roas (gt/gte/lt/lte); campaign_cost (gt/gte/lt/lte); campaign_engagement_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); campaign_revenue (gt/gte/lt/lte); campaign_roi (gt/gte/lt/lte); click_through_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); cost (gt/gte/lt/lte); creative_cost (gt/gte/lt/lte); creative_ctr (gt/gte/lt/lte); creative_orders (gt/gte/lt/lte); creative_revenue (gt/gte/lt/lte); creative_roi (gt/gte/lt/lte); impressions (gt/gte/lt/lte); orders (gt/gte/lt/lte); organic_engagement_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); product_ad_click_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); product_ad_clicks (gt/gte/lt/lte); total_creative_boost_cost (lt).

operator.title: Operator
operator.description: Comparison operator; each metric's operators are listed under `metric`.

value.title: Value
value.description: Threshold the metric is compared against.

lookback_days.title: Lookback Days
lookback_days.description: How many days of history the metric is computed over. Default 3.

ConditionRule.title: ConditionRule
ConditionRule.description:
A Creative Boost `if` condition — one definition for the portal, the Public
API and the MCP.

The shape also accepts the exclusion vocabulary (``NUMERIC_METRIC_KEYS`` and the
campaign-average ``RELATIVE_OPERATORS``, which carry no fixed value — CORE-7929),
but the boost worker evaluates only the pairs in
``boost_rule_vocabulary.ENFORCEABLE_CONDITIONS``. The controller refuses any
other pair instead of storing a rule the worker would skip (G-01).

metric.description: Metric to evaluate. Creative Boost evaluates (metric (operators)): 2s_video_view_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); boost_revenue (gt/gte/lt/lte); boost_roas (gt/gte/lt/lte); campaign_cost (gt/gte/lt/lte); campaign_engagement_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); campaign_revenue (gt/gte/lt/lte); campaign_roi (gt/gte/lt/lte); click_through_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); cost (gt/gte/lt/lte); creative_cost (gt/gte/lt/lte); creative_ctr (gt/gte/lt/lte); creative_orders (gt/gte/lt/lte); creative_revenue (gt/gte/lt/lte); creative_roi (gt/gte/lt/lte); impressions (gt/gte/lt/lte); orders (gt/gte/lt/lte); organic_engagement_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); product_ad_click_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); product_ad_clicks (gt/gte/lt/lte); total_creative_boost_cost (lt).

operator.description: Comparison operator; each metric's operators are listed under `metric`.

value.title: Value
value.description: Threshold the metric is compared against.

lookback_days.title: Lookback Days
lookback_days.description: How many days of history the metric is computed over. Default 3.

ConditionRulePublic.title: ConditionRulePublic
ConditionRulePublic.description: One condition row in an automation's trigger logic.

ContractEnvelopeOut.title: ContractEnvelopeOut
ContractEnvelopeOut.description: Always includes ``terms`` so the FE can render the preview without a second round-trip.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency. The wallet's persisted currency overrides this for cross-currency safety.

success_url.title: Success Url
success_url.description: URL Stripe redirects to on completion. Must use a Reacher-controlled host (app.reacherapp.com, portal.reacherapp.com, staging.reacherapp.com) or localhost/127.0.0.1 for development.

CreateDepositIntentRequest.title: CreateDepositIntentRequest
CreateDepositIntentRequest.description:
``POST /public/v1/campaigns/payments/deposit-intent`` — return a
Stripe Checkout session that the caller can redirect the user to
in order to top up the shop's marketplace wallet.

Creating the intent does NOT move any money; money moves only when
the user completes the hosted Stripe flow and Stripe's webhook
confirms the deposit. Public API never sees the webhook itself.

CreateDraftDryRunResponse.title: CreateDraftDryRunResponse
CreateDraftDryRunResponse.description:
Shape for ``X-Dry-Run: true`` on create. Echoes what would be
persisted without actually inserting (and without resolving the
conversation either — pure validation echo, same posture as the
live-send dry-run paths).

creator_handle.title: Creator Handle
creator_handle.description: The creator's TikTok handle (with or without leading @). Must already have an open conversation with this shop — drafts can only be staged on existing conversations, the same prerequisite TikTok enforces on the live-send path.

text.title: Text
text.description: Plain-text reply body. Set this OR `image_url` OR `product_id` (exactly one). `message` is accepted as an alias: it is what an assistant reaches for, and with extra=forbid the mismatch was a schema rejection before the clearer route-level validation below could run (CORE-6957).

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: HTTPS URL of an image to send. Same SSRF + size + type constraints as the live /reply/image endpoint will apply when the human ships the draft — we do NOT fetch the URL at draft time (no outbound network call from this endpoint). Set this OR `text` OR `product_id` (exactly one).

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: A TikTok product_id from THIS shop's catalog. Ownership is verified ONLY when the human clicks Send in the inbox — the draft endpoint does not pre-check the catalog (the catalog can change between draft and send anyway). Set this OR `text` OR `image_url` (exactly one).

CreateDraftRequest.title: CreateDraftRequest
CreateDraftRequest.description:
Body for ``POST /creator-messages/draft``.

Exactly one of `text`, `image_url`, `product_id` must be set — matches
the three live-send endpoints. Validated below in `_resolve_draft_content`
so a malformed body is rejected at the route layer with a single
structured 400 (rather than 5 separate model-level rules whose error
messages would be harder for an agent to act on).

`creator_handle` is in the BODY (not the path) for the create endpoint
— keeps the path stable as ``/creator-messages/draft`` regardless of
content type. Mirrors how the existing /reply* paths are
creator-scoped via the URL while the create-draft surface is
deliberately content-shape agnostic.

CreateDraftResponse.title: CreateDraftResponse
CreateDraftResponse.description: 201-create response — same shape as a single draft row.

campaign_name.title: Campaign Name
campaign_name.description: Human-readable campaign name shown in Seller Center / the portal.

campaign_type.title: Campaign Type
campaign_type.description: `product` (Product GMV Max) or `live` (LIVE GMV Max). Maps to TikTok `shopping_ads_type` PRODUCT / LIVE.

product_selection.title: Product Selection
product_selection.description: `all` promotes every eligible product; `customized` restricts to the products in `item_group_ids`. Maps to TikTok `product_specific_type` ALL / CUSTOMIZED_PRODUCTS.

item_group_ids.title: Item Group Ids
item_group_ids.description: Product (SPU / item_group_id) IDs to promote. Required and non-empty when `product_selection` is `customized`; must be omitted when `product_selection` is `all`.

target_roas.title: Target Roas
target_roas.description: Target ROAS. Required — TikTok GMV Max create always needs a target ROI: maps to TikTok `roas_bid` with `deep_bid_type=VO_MIN_ROAS`.

daily_budget.title: Daily Budget
daily_budget.description: Daily budget in the shop's currency. Maps to TikTok `budget`.

schedule_type.title: Schedule Type
schedule_type.description: `from_now` starts immediately with no end (TikTok SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW); `start_end` runs between `schedule_start_time` and `schedule_end_time` (TikTok SCHEDULE_START_END).

schedule_start_time.title: Schedule Start Time
schedule_start_time.description: Campaign start time, TikTok format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. Required for both `from_now` and `start_end` (TikTok always requires it).

schedule_end_time.title: Schedule End Time
schedule_end_time.description: Campaign end time, TikTok format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`. Required when `schedule_type` is `start_end`.

promotion_days.title: Promotion Days
promotion_days.description: Optional number of promotion days (LIVE GMV Max scheduling hint).

auto_budget_enabled.title: Auto Budget Enabled
auto_budget_enabled.description: Optional: let TikTok auto-manage the budget.

affiliate_posts_enabled.title: Affiliate Posts Enabled
affiliate_posts_enabled.description: Optional: allow affiliate creator posts to be used as creatives.

content_inspiration.title: Content Inspiration
content_inspiration.description: Inspiration videos. Entries missing `key_points` get them AI-generated from the video's analysis on save. At most 50 entries.

CreativeBriefUpdateRequest.title: CreativeBriefUpdateRequest
CreativeBriefUpdateRequest.description:
Full-document update for one creative brief (the portal's save action).

This is a replace, not a patch: the portal's editor always submits the whole
document, and the stored `brief_content` blob is rebuilt from these fields.
Omitted fields therefore reset to their defaults — send back what
`GET /creative-briefs/{brief_id}` returned, with your edits applied.

`image_urls` is a plain ordered list here; the portal's index-keyed object
with its `"uploaded"` sentinel is an upload-widget artifact, not a contract
worth publishing. File uploads are portal-only — pass already-hosted URLs.

pagination.description: Standard meta block; `page` is the page containing the first returned row (offset // limit + 1). Navigate with offset/limit here, or use offsets that are multiples of limit.

unread_conversations.title: Unread Conversations
unread_conversations.description: Number of conversations with at least one unread message (NOT the number of unread messages — see /creator-messages/stats `unread_messages` for that). Independent of the unread_only filter.

unreplied_conversations.title: Unreplied Conversations
unreplied_conversations.description: Number of conversations whose last message came from the creator (awaiting a shop reply). Independent of the unreplied_only filter.

product_categories.title: Product Categories
product_categories.description: TikTok Shop product category names (e.g. 'Beauty & Personal Care').

age_range.title: Age Range
age_range.description: Age buckets, e.g. ['18-24', '25-34']. Buckets are platform-defined.

community.title: Community
community.description: Community hashtags the creators post under. Available where the community-hashtag pipeline has coverage (currently US/UK/DE/ES) — GET /ai-search/hashtags is the live source of truth and returns valid hashtags for your region (404 where unsupported); a leading '#' is optional. Resolves the same audience the portal's community filter builds — the lever behind large niche segments (e.g. fitness) that product category alone can't target.

CreatorFilters.title: CreatorFilters
CreatorFilters.description:
Dynamic creator selection by attribute. When `is_evergreen=true` on
the parent automation, the filter is re-evaluated on every run.

Mirrors the portal's "Filters" tab (formDataTransformer.ts:735-824
`buildFilters` for the legacy `config.Filters` shape, and
`buildAISearchFilters` for the AI-search variant). The translator
splits AI-only fields out into `config.ai_search_filters` and sets
`config.uses_ai_filters=true` accordingly.

All fields are optional — set only the ones you care about. An empty
`CreatorFilters({})` is invalid (use `lists` mode instead).

status.title: Status
status.description: Display status from rev_status_mapping()

overall_gmv.title: Overall Gmv
overall_gmv.description: Overall GMV from regional creator table. DB: Creator.gmv_num

creator_level.title: Creator Level
creator_level.description: GMV tier L0–L7, using the same thresholds as the dashboard's 'Creators by Level' chart (derived from overall_gmv: L0=$0, L1<$5k, L2<$25k, L3<$60k, L4<$150k, L5<$400k, L6<$1.0M, L7≥$1.0M). Null when overall GMV is unavailable for the creator.

overall_fulfillment_rate.title: Overall Fulfillment Rate
overall_fulfillment_rate.description: Overall fulfillment rate from regional creator table

CreatorMessageDraft.title: CreatorMessageDraft
CreatorMessageDraft.description:
One draft row, as returned by create / list / delete echo paths.

Mirrors the column shape in ``conversation_message_drafts``. Only the
field matching `content_type` is populated — for `text` drafts,
`text_content` is set and `payload` is `{}`; for `image` drafts
`payload = {"image_url": "..."}`; for `product` drafts
`payload = {"product_id": "..."}`. Keeping the response shape tight
means an agent caller can render the draft without parsing more than
necessary.

sent_via.title: Sent Via
sent_via.description: For shop messages sent through Reacher: 'inbox' (a person in the Reacher inbox), 'api' (a Public API key) or 'mcp' (an agent through the MCP connector). Null for creator messages and history synced from TikTok.

CreatorMessageItem.title: CreatorMessageItem
CreatorMessageItem.description:
A single creator-conversation message.

The `text` field is populated for plain-text messages. For richer types
(image, product card, target-collab card, free-sample card, CRM cards)
the matching nested object below carries the type-specific payload —
only the one matching `content_type` is populated; the rest are null.
AI agents need these payloads to understand what was actually sent
(image URL, product_id, invitation_group_id, etc.); without them a
non-text content_type leaves the caller blind.

total_conversations.title: Total Conversations
total_conversations.description: Total conversations with message data for the shop.

unread_conversations.title: Unread Conversations
unread_conversations.description: Conversations with at least one unread message.

unreplied_conversations.title: Unreplied Conversations
unreplied_conversations.description: Conversations whose last message was from the creator (awaiting a shop reply).

unread_messages.title: Unread Messages
unread_messages.description: SUM of unread messages across all conversations — the total unread badge number. Distinct from `unread_conversations`.

has_data.title: Has Data
has_data.description: True if the shop has any conversation with message data.

CreatorMessageStatsResponse.title: CreatorMessageStatsResponse
CreatorMessageStatsResponse.description:
Inbox unread/unreplied stats for the shop.

`unread_conversations` counts conversations with any unread message;
`unread_messages` sums the unread messages inside them — a conversation
with 5 unread adds 1 to the former and 5 to the latter.

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: Messages per page (fixed at 20 on this surface).

total_count.title: Total Count
total_count.description: Total messages in the conversation thread.

has_previous.title: Has Previous
has_previous.description: True when `page` > 1 and there is data.

gmv.title: Gmv
gmv.description: GMV earned in the date range (not lifetime)

follower_count.title: Follower Count
follower_count.description: Latest follower count in the period

CreatorPerformanceItem.title: CreatorPerformanceItem
CreatorPerformanceItem.description: Creator with period-specific metrics from creator_info (daily table).

shops_queried.title: Shops Queried
shops_queried.description: Shop names included when querying multiple shops (x-shop-id: all or comma-separated).

shops_queried.title: Shops Queried
shops_queried.description: Shop names included when querying multiple shops (x-shop-id: all or comma-separated).

CreatorReplyDryRunResponse.title: CreatorReplyDryRunResponse
CreatorReplyDryRunResponse.description:
Shape returned for `X-Dry-Run: true` (HTTP 200). Distinct from the
201 send response — nothing is sent, so there is no message id.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: HTTPS URL of an image to forward to the creator. We fetch it server-side (must resolve to a public IP, return Content-Type image/*, ≤ 5 MB), then upload to TikTok and dispatch.

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: A TikTok product_id from THIS shop's catalog. Sending another shop's product_id is rejected with 400.

message.title: Message
message.description: Plain-text reply body to send to the creator.

CreatorSource.title: CreatorSource
CreatorSource.description: How creators are sourced for a campaign.

CreatorStateChangeResponse.title: CreatorStateChangeResponse
CreatorStateChangeResponse.description: Response shape shared by accept / reject / reactivate.

CreatorStatus.title: CreatorStatus
CreatorStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a creator within a campaign.

CreatorTrendSeries.title: CreatorTrendSeries
CreatorTrendSeries.description:
Six parallel daily series. Every array has one entry per day in the
window, ordered oldest → newest, aligned positionally with `days`.

creator_handles.title: Creator Handles
creator_handles.description: Creator handles to fetch series for. Max 100 per call — this mirrors the internal per-page cap and keeps the response bounded. Handles that don't resolve in this shop are reported in `unresolved_handles`.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Window start (inclusive). Omit for a trailing 28-day window ending at end_date.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Window end (inclusive). Defaults to today.

data.title: Data
data.description: Keyed by creator handle. Creators with no activity are zero-filled, not omitted.

days.title: Days
days.description: ISO date axis for every series in `data`.

unresolved_handles.title: Unresolved Handles
unresolved_handles.description: Requested handles with no creator record in this shop. Absent from `data`.

shops_queried.title: Shops Queried
shops_queried.description: Shop names included when querying multiple shops (x-shop-id: all or comma-separated).

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Window start (inclusive). Omit for a trailing 28-day window ending at end_date.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Window end (inclusive). Defaults to today.

new_creators.title: New Creators
new_creators.description: Creators whose first-ever CRM record falls inside the window.

gmv_generated.title: Gmv Generated
gmv_generated.description: Affiliate-attributed GMV earned in the window.

video_posts.title: Video Posts
video_posts.description: Distinct videos posted in the window.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Affiliate orders placed in the window.

crm_groups.title: Crm Groups
crm_groups.description: UUIDs of existing CRM Groups whose current members should be excluded. Use `GET /crm-groups` to discover.

exclude_previously_messaged.title: Exclude Previously Messaged
exclude_previously_messaged.description: Skip creators this shop has DM'd before in any prior automation. Maps to config.exclude_previously_messaged.

CreatorsToExclude.title: CreatorsToExclude
CreatorsToExclude.description:
Outreach-paradigm recipient exclusion. Mirrors `creators_to_omit` in
the legacy DB column / frontend payload, plus the boolean
`exclude_previously_messaged` flag from the portal's Exclude Creators panel.

list_upload.title: List Upload
list_upload.description: Ad-hoc creator handles (TikTok @-names) to include in this automation only. NOT persisted as a Lists row.

lists_selected.title: Lists Selected
lists_selected.description: IDs of existing Lists (vault_files.resource_id) whose creators should be included. Use `POST /lists` to upload reusable lists.

filters.description: Dynamic creator selection by attribute. When set, the parent automation's `is_evergreen=true` flag re-evaluates the filter on every run. Mutually exclusive with `list_upload`/`lists_selected` and `crm_group_id`.

crm_group_id.title: Crm Group Id
crm_group_id.description: Single CRM group ID (UUID string). Membership is dynamic — the runtime re-evaluates on every send. Mutually exclusive with the other two modes. Use `GET /crm-groups` to discover available groups (returns the canonical IDs to pass here).

crm_group_entered_after.title: Crm Group Entered After
crm_group_entered_after.description: Optional CRM-group filter — only include members who entered the group ON or AFTER this date. Ignored unless `crm_group_id` is set.

crm_group_entered_before.title: Crm Group Entered Before
crm_group_entered_before.description: Optional CRM-group filter — only include members who entered the group ON or BEFORE this date. Ignored unless `crm_group_id` is set.

CreatorsToInclude.title: CreatorsToInclude
CreatorsToInclude.description:
Outreach-paradigm recipient inclusion. Three mutually-exclusive
modes (cf. INTERNAL-design-review.md §11A):

  * `lists` mode — `list_upload` and/or `lists_selected` populated
  * `filters` mode — `filters` populated (dynamic by attribute)
  * `crm_group` mode — `crm_group_id` populated (saved predicate)

The validator below rejects any request that mixes modes. The
`creator_source_type` discriminator written to `config` is derived
from which mode is set — callers don't need to set it explicitly.

CrmContentItem.title: CrmContentItem
CrmContentItem.description: One piece of content a creator posted for a product.

has_shop_data.title: Has Shop Data
has_shop_data.description: Whether this shop has any record of the creator — a sample request, posted content, an affiliate sale or a live session. `false` means the handle resolved only off the fleet-wide creator registry, so every shop-scoped figure below is structurally empty rather than genuinely zero. Distinguishes 'no relationship with this shop' from 'related, but nothing has happened yet'.

CrmCreatorDetailData.title: CrmCreatorDetailData
CrmCreatorDetailData.description: Creator Profile drawer: identity + shop/affiliate performance.

operator.title: Operator
operator.description: e.g. 'is_one_of', 'is_not_one_of', 'gte'. Groups built with the v2 builder can also carry 'has_all_of' / 'has_only' (match every / only the listed values) and 'between' / 'not_between' (a numeric or day range).

value.title: Value
value.description: Usually a list of selected values. For a v2 range, SKU pick or LIVE window it is an object: {values?, min?, max?, skus?, sku_count?, window?}, where `max: null` means no upper bound.

value_count.title: Value Count
value_count.description: Set only when `value` is a long list that has been sampled down. It is the true length; `value` holds the first 50 entries. Groups built from a dashboard segment store their whole membership inline, so this is common on those. Read the group's `creator_count` for its size, not `len(value)`.

group_name.title: Group Name
group_name.description: Name for the new group. Creation upserts by (shop, group_name) — reusing a name overwrites that group's definition and re-materializes its members.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: GMV tier code to narrow the segment, e.g. 'L3'. Omit for all tiers.

automation_id.title: Automation Id
automation_id.description: Restrict the segment to creators reached by this automation.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Segment window start (inclusive).

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Segment window end (inclusive).

group_tags.title: Group Tags
group_tags.description: Optional tags to attach to the group.

crm_group_id.title: Crm Group Id
crm_group_id.description: UUID of the created group. Null on a dry run.

creator_count.title: Creator Count
creator_count.description: Creators actually materialized into the group — those that mapped to a CRM record. This is the group's real size.

handles_resolved.title: Handles Resolved
handles_resolved.description: Creators the segment matched before CRM mapping. Always >= creator_count; the gap between the two is the drop-off from creators that have no CRM record (DM-only and organic creators cannot be grouped).

crm_group_id.title: Crm Group Id
crm_group_id.description: UUID — stable across creator membership changes.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Filter conditions joined with AND. Membership semantics depend on how the group was built: filter-built groups are dynamic and creators flow in/out as their attributes change, while groups created from a dashboard segment (POST /crm-groups/from-segment) are snapshots whose members were fixed at creation. A single `creatorNames` condition is the signal for the latter.

last_synced_at.title: Last Synced At
last_synced_at.description: Group DEFINITION write time (`crm_groups.updated_at`), NOT a membership evaluation — it can be far older than the members (an edit doesn't even bump it). For membership freshness read ``members_last_changed_at``. Kept for backward-compat.

members_last_changed_at.title: Members Last Changed At
members_last_changed_at.description: When a creator most recently entered this group (MAX crm_creator_group_mappings.added_date) — the freshness signal the portal shows. Null if the group has no members.

CrmProductCardItem.title: CrmProductCardItem
CrmProductCardItem.description: Single product within a CRM text with products card.

creator_name.title: Creator Name
creator_name.description: Public TikTok handle. Never the creator's real name.

bio.title: Bio
bio.description: The creator's TikTok profile bio/signature text. Null when not scraped for this creator.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Broad TikTok Shop product categories the creator has sold across (the whole set, not a single niche/content label).

curr_status.title: Curr Status
curr_status.description: Sample/collaboration status as a display label (e.g. `Content Pending`) — the upstream roster already resolves the raw TikTok code before it reaches this surface.

status.title: Status
status.description: Alias of `curr_status`, kept for caller convenience.

gmv.title: Gmv
gmv.description: Lifetime GMV this creator drove for this shop.

creator_gmv.title: Creator Gmv
creator_gmv.description: The creator's total GMV across all shops.

affiliate_gmv_28d.title: Affiliate Gmv 28D
affiliate_gmv_28d.description: Trailing-28-day affiliate GMV. Null when the shop has no affiliate ledger — deliberately not zero-filled.

CrmRosterCreator.title: CrmRosterCreator
CrmRosterCreator.description: One roster row: the surviving (creator × product) record per creator.

status.title: Status
status.description: Display status label for this creator × product.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: Remaining sample stock for the SKU (`sku_left_num`).

CrmRosterProduct.title: CrmRosterProduct
CrmRosterProduct.description: A product the creator is (or was) collaborating on.

CrmStatusTransition.title: CrmStatusTransition
CrmStatusTransition.description: One observed status change for a (creator, product) pair.

creator_ids.title: Creator Ids
creator_ids.description: Creator identifiers from the CRM roster (GET /crm/creators → `creator_id`). Tags apply to every product-row of each creator. Max 1000 per request.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tags to add. Re-adding a tag a creator already has is a no-op. Max 50 tags per request; per-tag and total-byte limits are enforced server-side.

CrmTagsAddRequest.title: CrmTagsAddRequest
CrmTagsAddRequest.description: POST /crm/tags/add request body — add tags to CRM creators.

creator_ids.title: Creator Ids
creator_ids.description: Creator identifiers from the CRM roster (GET /crm/creators → `creator_id`). Max 1000 per request.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tags to remove. Ignored when `all_tags` is true.

all_tags.title: All Tags
all_tags.description: Remove EVERY tag from the named creators (ignores `tags`).

CrmTagsRemoveRequest.title: CrmTagsRemoveRequest
CrmTagsRemoveRequest.description: POST /crm/tags/remove request body — remove tags from CRM creators.

creators_updated.title: Creators Updated
creators_updated.description: Number of creator rows whose tag set actually changed. Adding a tag a creator already has, or removing one it doesn't have, is a no-op and is not counted — so this can be less than the number of creator_ids sent (including 0 when nothing changed).

tags.title: Tags
