tags.description: The tags that were added/removed (empty when all_tags was used).

all_tags.title: All Tags
all_tags.description: True if every tag was removed (remove only).

CrmTextWithImageCardContent.title: CrmTextWithImageCardContent
CrmTextWithImageCardContent.description: CRM text with image card content fields.

CrmTextWithProductsCardContent.title: CrmTextWithProductsCardContent
CrmTextWithProductsCardContent.description: CRM text with products card content fields.

DealTerms.title: DealTerms
DealTerms.description: One creator's retainer deal, set by the brand on approval.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code every amount in this response is denominated in.

redirect_url.title: Redirect Url
redirect_url.description: URL to redirect the user to in order to complete the deposit. No money moves until the user finishes Stripe's hosted checkout.

DiscordAttachment.title: DiscordAttachment
DiscordAttachment.description: One attachment on a message (the storage location stays internal).

can_post.title: Can Post
can_post.description: Whether the bot can actually post here.

missing_permissions.title: Missing Permissions
missing_permissions.description: Permissions the bot lacks here (VIEW_CHANNEL, SEND_MESSAGES, MANAGE_WEBHOOKS); empty when can_post is true.

DiscordDeleteResponse.title: DiscordDeleteResponse
DiscordDeleteResponse.description: Envelope docs for the delete route (runtime returns a JSONResponse).

deleted_id.title: Deleted Id
deleted_id.description: The id that was (or, on a dry run, would be) deleted.

data_base64.title: Data Base64
data_base64.description: The file's bytes, base64-encoded. Max 8MB decoded, ≤10 files per message.

DiscordImage.title: DiscordImage
DiscordImage.description:
An image / file to attach, sent inline as base64 (no upload step, no
URL fetch — keeps the JSON contract MCP-callable and free of SSRF).

sender.description: Server member the post is shown as; `null` = the brand.

status.title: Status
status.description: `scheduled`, `sending`, `sent`, `failed`, or `canceled`.

series_id.title: Series Id
series_id.description: Set on an occurrence of a recurring series.

upcoming_occurrences.title: Upcoming Occurrences
upcoming_occurrences.description: Next fire times, on a recurring series' detail read.

DiscordMessage.title: DiscordMessage
DiscordMessage.description:
A posted or scheduled message, with its engagement once delivered.

A curated projection of the internal record — pipeline internals (delivery
log, retry bookkeeping, rendered body, portal author identity) stay internal.

title.title: Title
title.description: Optional bold header rendered above the body.

scheduled_for.title: Scheduled For
scheduled_for.description: When to post (ISO 8601). Omit to post immediately.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA tz for the schedule (defaults to the shop's).

recurrence.description: Repeat the message. `frequency` is one of `daily`, `weekdays`, `weekly`, `biweekly`, `monthly`; end with `end_type` `never` / `on` (+`until`) / `after` (+`occurrences`). Requires `scheduled_for` as the first fire.

campaign_id.title: Campaign Id
campaign_id.description: Optional campaign to associate the post with.

sender_user_id.title: Sender User Id
sender_user_id.description: Discord user id of a member of the linked server to post AS — the message shows their server nickname and avatar instead of the brand's (Discord still marks it APP). Omit to post as the brand. Bots and non-members are rejected with 400.

images.title: Images
images.description: Up to 10 images / files to attach (e.g. a video-breakdown image), each base64-encoded and ≤ 8MB decoded.

DiscordMessageCreateRequest.title: DiscordMessageCreateRequest
DiscordMessageCreateRequest.description:
Post now, schedule, or start a recurring series.

Omit ``scheduled_for`` (and ``recurrence``) to post immediately — the route
runs the delivery pipeline inline and returns the final ``sent`` / ``failed``
record. A ``recurrence`` requires ``scheduled_for`` (the first fire).

DiscordMessageWriteResponse.title: DiscordMessageWriteResponse
DiscordMessageWriteResponse.description: Envelope docs for the create route (runtime returns a JSONResponse).

channel_id.title: Channel Id
channel_id.description: Channel to post the reply into.

DiscordReplyResponse.title: DiscordReplyResponse
DiscordReplyResponse.description: Envelope docs for the reply route (runtime returns a JSONResponse).

replied_to_message_id.title: Replied To Message Id
replied_to_message_id.description: The message id this reply answers (from the path).

discord_message_id.title: Discord Message Id
discord_message_id.description: Id of the reply Discord assigned, once posted.

sort_by.title: Sort By
sort_by.description: Column to sort by. One of: relevance_score, follower_count, gmv_num, avg_views, engagement_rate_segment.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Extra filters applied on top of the profile's own query and filters — same shape as the AI-search filter payload, e.g. ``{"Performance": {"GMV": ["$5K-$10K"]}, "emailFilter": true}``. Omit to get the profile's unmodified result set.

DiscoveryCreatorsBody.title: DiscoveryCreatorsBody
DiscoveryCreatorsBody.description: Paging, sort and extra filters for one profile's creator listing.

title.title: Title
title.description: Human-readable name for the brief. The stored title is regenerated from `search_query` + `filters`, so it may come back normalized rather than exactly as sent.

search_query.title: Search Query
search_query.description: Natural-language description of the creators you want, e.g. 'skincare creators who film get-ready-with-me content'.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional longer note about what this brief is for.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Structured demographic filters layered on top of the query — ``{"Gender": ["female"], "Age": ["25-34"], "Ethnicity": [...], "Region": [...]}``. Single values are normalized to arrays.

DiscoveryProfileCreateBody.title: DiscoveryProfileCreateBody
DiscoveryProfileCreateBody.description: A new Discovery Agent creator brief.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Replaces the stored demographic filters wholesale.

is_active.title: Is Active
is_active.description: Whether the brief is refreshed on the usual schedule.

is_hidden.title: Is Hidden
is_hidden.description: Hide the brief from the profile list without deleting it.

hide_unsafe.title: Hide Unsafe
hide_unsafe.description: Exclude brand-unsafe creators from the match set.

DiscoveryProfileUpdateBody.title: DiscoveryProfileUpdateBody
DiscoveryProfileUpdateBody.description:
Partial update for one Discovery Agent profile.

Only the fields you send are touched. ``is_deleted`` is deliberately absent:
deleting is ``DELETE /discovery/profiles/{profile_id}``, so a PATCH can
never silently retire a brief.

include_emails.title: Include Emails
include_emails.description: Also save the creators' email list alongside the handle list. Required if you intend to drive an email automation from it.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Extra filters narrowing the saved set, same shape as the AI-search filter payload. The profile itself is not modified.

DiscoverySaveToListBody.title: DiscoverySaveToListBody
DiscoverySaveToListBody.description: Materialize a profile's match set into a Vault list.

DmConfig.title: DmConfig
DmConfig.description: DM type-specific config blob, populated based on `mode`.

DmConfigPatchPayload.title: DmConfigPatchPayload
DmConfigPatchPayload.description: All-Optional companion to `DmConfig` for PATCH bodies.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. Set false to persist the config without personalizing sends (e.g. staging copy for later).

tone.title: Tone
tone.description: AI rewrite tone. Null uses the engine default (engaging).

fallback_message.title: Fallback Message
fallback_message.description: Sent when a creator has too little signal to personalize. Required — personalization must always have a safe fallback.

offer_discussion.title: Offer Discussion
offer_discussion.description: [Offer Discussion] block value — your offer text.

product_description.title: Product Description
product_description.description: [Product Description] block value. Pre-resolve via POST /personalization/product-blocks.

product_selling_points.title: Product Selling Points
product_selling_points.description: [Product Selling Points] block value. Pre-resolve via POST /personalization/product-blocks.

word_counts.title: Word Counts
word_counts.description: Optional approximate word-count target per AI block, e.g. {"content_discussion": 25, "product_discussion": 20}. Only the two AI blocks (content_discussion, product_discussion) are honored; values are clamped to a sane range server-side. Null/absent uses the engine brevity default.

name_source.title: Name Source
name_source.description: Which name fills the creator-name token (CORE-7779). ``first_name`` (default) uses the first name on the creator's most recent TikTok order -- a shipping name, which can differ from how they present on TikTok. ``display_name`` puts their TikTok display name first, falling back to the first name and then the handle when it isn't a usable name.

DmPersonalizationConfig.title: DmPersonalizationConfig
DmPersonalizationConfig.description:
CORE-4857 — enable AI personalization of the initial-outreach DM.

When set on ``POST /automations/dm``, the send engine rewrites the DM body
per creator using the [Block] tokens in your message text: Content
Discussion and Product Discussion are AI-generated from the creator's own
signals, while Product Description / Selling Points / Offer are the fixed
strings you provide here. A creator with too little signal to personalize
receives ``fallback_message`` instead.

All copy fields are stored verbatim — there is NO server-side AI at create
time — so the create is deterministic and idempotent, and the send path's
reuse hash stays stable. Resolve the product blocks beforehand via
``POST /personalization/product-blocks`` and preview any creator via
``POST /personalization/preview`` so what ships is what you approved.

spark_code_submission_url.title: Spark Code Submission Url
spark_code_submission_url.description: Portal-hosted form URL. Auto-generated if not provided by the route.

DmSparkCodeConfig.title: DmSparkCodeConfig
DmSparkCodeConfig.description: dm-mode=spark_code — TikTok spark code collection form.

pagination.description: Standard meta block (derived from page/page_size/total when omitted).

DraftListResponse.title: DraftListResponse
DraftListResponse.description:
Paginated list. Mirrors the public-API pagination shape from
`/automations/list` and friends: `data` array + pagination meta.

status.title: Status
status.description: Account status: 'active' when the inbox is usable, otherwise the stored state (e.g. an error state). Archived / disconnected accounts are not returned by this endpoint.

EmailAccountItem.title: EmailAccountItem
EmailAccountItem.description: One connected email account (inbox) usable to back an email automation.

shops_queried.title: Shops Queried
shops_queried.description: Shop names included when querying multiple shops.

EmailAccountsListResponse.title: EmailAccountsListResponse
EmailAccountsListResponse.description:
Connected email accounts for the requested shop(s). Read-only. Tokens are
never included.

url.title: Url
url.description: Hosted HTTPS URL of the attachment. Reacher fetches the file from this URL at create time, runs the standard upload validation pipeline (size, MIME type, virus scan), and re-hosts to internal storage. The provided URL is NOT used at send time — only at create time.

EmailAttachment.title: EmailAttachment
EmailAttachment.description:
Email automation attachment. Per architecture review 2026-05-01:
the API NEVER accepts file uploads — callers provide a hosted HTTPS
URL and the server fetches + re-hosts to internal storage.

email_sent_per_day.title: Email Sent Per Day
email_sent_per_day.description: Maximum emails per day this automation sends from its inbox.

EmailAutomationUpdateRequest.title: EmailAutomationUpdateRequest
EmailAutomationUpdateRequest.description:
Body for PATCH /automations/email/{id}. All fields optional; supply only
what changes. At least one must be present. Recipient audience
(mailing_list / filters) is not editable here — recreate the automation to
change who it targets.

shops_queried.title: Shops Queried
shops_queried.description: Shop names included when querying multiple shops.

EmailAutomationsListResponse.title: EmailAutomationsListResponse
EmailAutomationsListResponse.description: Paginated list of email automations for the requested shop(s).

emails_sent_today.title: Emails Sent Today
emails_sent_today.description: Emails sent by this shop today (server date).

daily_limit.title: Daily Limit
daily_limit.description: The denominator the portal's daily-send bar shows.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: CRM/funnel stage to target, e.g. 'Content Pending', 'Sample Approved', 'Sample Shipped'. Uses the same stage names as the sample/funnel listings; an unrecognized name is rejected with the list of accepted stages.

EmailCrmStage.title: EmailCrmStage
EmailCrmStage.description:
selection_mode=crm_stage — recipients resolved on the server from the
creators currently in a CRM/funnel stage, then their email addresses.

Point an email automation at a stage (e.g. "Content Pending") and the
server looks up which creators are in that stage for this shop and pulls
their email addresses, so the caller does not have to fetch the stage and
build a recipient list by hand. Emails come from the same source the
creator listing uses; a creator with no email on file is skipped, so the
reachable audience can be smaller than the stage — the create response
reports both counts under `config.recipient_coverage`. A stage that
resolves to zero reachable emails is rejected at create time.

EmailFilters.title: EmailFilters
EmailFilters.description:
selection_mode=filters — recipients via creator search filters.
Subset of the saved_searches.filters JSONB shape — fields that make sense
for email outreach. Backend translates this into the legacy filters JSON.

EmailMailingList.title: EmailMailingList
EmailMailingList.description:
selection_mode=mailing_list — recipients via uploaded emails or
existing Lists (vault_files with non-empty `creator_emails`).

NOTE: lists referenced by `lists_selected` MUST contain at least one
email address — the `vault_files.creator_emails` JSONB column must be
non-empty. Targeting requires emails to send to. The route validates
this at create time and returns 400 `LIST_MISSING_EMAILS` for any
list that lacks emails. Per architecture review 2026-05-01.

default.title: Default
default.description: Cap a newly created email automation gets.

minimum.title: Minimum
minimum.description: Floor a cap is clamped up to.

maximum.title: Maximum
maximum.description: Ceiling a cap is clamped down to; null when uncapped.

EmailTierLimits.title: EmailTierLimits
EmailTierLimits.description: The shop tier's emails/day entitlement, Extra Limits grants applied.

ExcludeVideosRequest.title: ExcludeVideosRequest
ExcludeVideosRequest.description: Exclude one or more videos from a campaign.

ExclusionReason.title: ExclusionReason
ExclusionReason.description: Why a brand excluded a video. Shown to the creator, so every code has copy.

ExclusionScope.title: ExclusionScope
ExclusionScope.description:
How far an uploaded file reaches.

``campaign`` is the default: the button lives on one campaign's Content tab
and acting only there is what a brand expects. ``shop`` is the opt-in that
also excludes the video from every other campaign it appears in, which is
the whole point of the upload but is far more destructive, so it is never
implied.

entity_id.title: Entity Id
entity_id.description: Seller ID for `brand`, product ID for `product`.

FavoriteWriteBody.title: FavoriteWriteBody
FavoriteWriteBody.description: One brand or product to add to the shop's watchlist.

entity_ids.title: Entity Ids
entity_ids.description: Favorited IDs, most recently added first.

FavoritesListResponse.title: FavoritesListResponse
FavoritesListResponse.description: The shop's watchlist for one entity type.

FilterRange.title: FilterRange
FilterRange.description:
Inclusive numeric range. At least one of `min` / `max` must be set;
the other is open-ended.

Used by `CreatorFilters` for every range-style filter (GMV, follower
count, average views, engagement rate, etc.). API exposes `{min, max}`
objects; the translator converts to the legacy `["custom:min-max"]`
string form `config.Filters` expects.

state.title: State
state.description: Latest statements-sync status: never_run | ok | empty | partial | scope_missing | unsupported | failed.

last_synced_at.title: Last Synced At
last_synced_at.description: ISO timestamp of the last completed statements window.

covered_from.title: Covered From
covered_from.description: ISO timestamp where the unbroken run of synced windows begins; nothing before it is known.

covered_until.title: Covered Until
covered_until.description: ISO timestamp up to which data is known to be complete (exclusive); the end of that same unbroken run.

transactions_backlog.title: Transactions Backlog
transactions_backlog.description: Statements whose line items have not fully landed yet.

FinanceDataStatus.title: FinanceDataStatus
FinanceDataStatus.description:
Freshness and reachability of this shop's finance statements.

``scope_missing`` means the shop's TikTok grant refused the finance scope on
the last sync; the fix is to re-authorize, not to retry.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: What reached the bank, after exchange.

bank_account_tail.title: Bank Account Tail
bank_account_tail.description: Last characters of the masked account.

FinancePaymentOut.title: FinancePaymentOut
FinancePaymentOut.description: One payout to the shop's bank account.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive payout-creation window start (UTC). Defaults to 29 days before ``end_date``.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (UTC). Defaults to yesterday.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Page offset; narrow the window instead of paging deeper.

FinancePaymentsRequest.title: FinancePaymentsRequest
FinancePaymentsRequest.description: POST /finance/payments request body — payouts in a window.

FinancePaymentsResponse.title: FinancePaymentsResponse
FinancePaymentsResponse.description: Payouts for one shop in a window, newest first.

statement_orders.title: Statement Orders
statement_orders.description: Distinct order ids on the statement's lines.

statement_adjustments.title: Statement Adjustments
statement_adjustments.description: Distinct adjustment ids on the statement's lines.

statement_reserves.title: Statement Reserves
statement_reserves.description: RESERVE lines on the statement; they have no P&L counterpart.

pnl_rows_linked.title: Pnl Rows Linked
pnl_rows_linked.description: P&L order and adjustment rows carrying this statement id.

pnl_orders_linked.title: Pnl Orders Linked
pnl_orders_linked.description: Distinct order ids among those P&L rows, in the statement's currency.

orders_only_in_statement.title: Orders Only In Statement
orders_only_in_statement.description: Settled on the statement but absent from the P&L export.

orders_only_in_pnl.title: Orders Only In Pnl
orders_only_in_pnl.description: Tagged with this statement in the P&L but not on its lines.

adjustments_only_in_statement.title: Adjustments Only In Statement
adjustments_only_in_statement.description: Adjustment ids on the statement absent from the P&L.

adjustments_only_in_pnl.title: Adjustments Only In Pnl
adjustments_only_in_pnl.description: Adjustment ids tagged with this statement in the P&L but not on its lines.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.description: Every currency seen on either side, plus the statement's own.

excluded_rows.title: Excluded Rows
excluded_rows.description: P&L rows in another currency, or with no currency; never matched.

unlinkable_rows.title: Unlinkable Rows
unlinkable_rows.description: P&L rows tagged with this statement that carry no order or adjustment id.

statement_rows_expected.title: Statement Rows Expected
statement_rows_expected.description: TikTok's own line count for the statement, when it was stored.

FinanceReconciliationLinkage.title: FinanceReconciliationLinkage
FinanceReconciliationLinkage.description:
Id-level overlap between a statement's lines and the P&L rows tagged with it.

Every count is a denominator as well as a result: ``statement_rows_scanned`` and
``pnl_rows_linked`` say how much was looked at, so an empty overlap never reads as clean.

transactions_complete.title: Transactions Complete
transactions_complete.description: Every line has landed; only then is a delta computed.

transactions_settlement_sum.title: Transactions Settlement Sum
transactions_settlement_sum.description: Sum of settlement_amount over the statement's lines; null until complete.

FollowUpStep.title: FollowUpStep
FollowUpStep.description:
One delayed follow-up after the initial outreach. Each step has a
delay (days after the prior step / initial outreach for the first
follow-up) and one or more addons that run together when the step
fires.

Per architecture review 2026-05-01 the API was refactored from a
single `messages: List[MessageStep]` array (with `step` discriminator)
into TWO arrays: `messages` for initial outreach, `follow_ups` for
delayed steps. Mirrors the runtime config shape (`config.addons[]`
vs `config.FOLLOW_UP_STEPS[]`) — the previous translator was
flattening follow-up addons into `config.addons[]` where the
runtime never reads them, silently dropping follow-up sends.

One creative's metrics for a single day.

``video_view_rate_*`` are TikTok-reported percentages (0–100) for this
creative on this day: ``2s`` / ``6s`` are the share of impressions watched
for at least 2 / 6 seconds; ``p25``–``p100`` are the share that watched to
25 / 50 / 75 / 100% of the video. Null when TikTok did not report the metric.

``video_view_rate_2s`` **is the thumbstop rate** (2-second views ÷
impressions × 100) — a creative clears a ``> 50`` thumbstop bar when this
field is above 50. Use ``impressions`` to weight it across a date range.

last_active_date.title: Last Active Date
last_active_date.description: Last day in the window with a metric row.

is_excluded.title: Is Excluded
is_excluded.description: True when the video is on the shop's GMV Max exclusion list.

exclusion_status.title: Exclusion Status
exclusion_status.description: applied_status of the exclusion row when `is_excluded` is true.

GmvMaxVideoSummaryItem.title: GmvMaxVideoSummaryItem
GmvMaxVideoSummaryItem.description: One video's GMV Max window totals across the campaigns it delivered in.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 29 days before ``end_date``.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to yesterday.

campaign_id.title: Campaign Id
campaign_id.description: Restrict to a single GMV Max campaign.

min_spend.title: Min Spend
min_spend.description: Only videos whose window spend is at least this amount.

GmvMaxVideoSummaryRequest.title: GmvMaxVideoSummaryRequest
GmvMaxVideoSummaryRequest.description:
POST /gmv-max/videos/summary — per-VIDEO GMV Max window totals for one
shop, across campaigns (the Ads Manager creative export, without the export).

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO currency code for the shop's region.

rule_type.title: Rule Type
rule_type.description: What the guardrail stops on. Creative Boost enforces (rule_type (operators)): total_creative_boost_cost (any operator — the value is the lifetime cap); 2s_video_view_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); boost_revenue (gt/gte/lt/lte); boost_roas (gt/gte/lt/lte); campaign_cost (gt/gte/lt/lte); campaign_revenue (gt/gte/lt/lte); campaign_roi (gt/gte/lt/lte); click_through_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); creative_ctr (gt/gte/lt/lte); creative_roi (gt/gte/lt/lte); impressions (gt/gte/lt/lte); orders (gt/gte/lt/lte); organic_engagement_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); product_ad_click_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); product_ad_clicks (gt/gte/lt/lte). `total_creative_boost_cost` is required on every `set_up_creative_boost` automation.

GuardrailRule.title: GuardrailRule
GuardrailRule.description:
A STOP IF rule: ``<rule_type> <operator> <value>``. Templates (``/templates``)
also carry preview-only rule types such as ``max_budget_daily``.

rule_type.description: What the guardrail stops on. Creative Boost enforces (rule_type (operators)): total_creative_boost_cost (any operator — the value is the lifetime cap); 2s_video_view_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); boost_revenue (gt/gte/lt/lte); boost_roas (gt/gte/lt/lte); campaign_cost (gt/gte/lt/lte); campaign_revenue (gt/gte/lt/lte); campaign_roi (gt/gte/lt/lte); click_through_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); creative_ctr (gt/gte/lt/lte); creative_roi (gt/gte/lt/lte); impressions (gt/gte/lt/lte); orders (gt/gte/lt/lte); organic_engagement_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); product_ad_click_rate (gt/gte/lt/lte); product_ad_clicks (gt/gte/lt/lte). `total_creative_boost_cost` is required on every `set_up_creative_boost` automation.

GuardrailRulePublic.title: GuardrailRulePublic
GuardrailRulePublic.description: A safety cap that prevents the automation from spending past a limit.

GuardrailRuleType.title: GuardrailRuleType
GuardrailRuleType.description:
What a guardrail stops on. ``total_creative_boost_cost`` (the lifetime
cap) is required on every creative boost automation. ``creative_revenue``,
``max_budget_daily`` and ``cooldown_hours`` are not enforced by the boost
engine and are refused with 422 ``UNENFORCEABLE_RULE``.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 29 days before ``end_date`` (a 30-day window). Max window 366 days.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to yesterday — today's revenue rows have not been pulled yet.

amazon_asins.title: Amazon Asins
amazon_asins.description: Restrict Amazon revenue and branded search to these ASINs. Omit for the shop total. Values come from ``GET /halo/products``.

shopify_product_ids.title: Shopify Product Ids
shopify_product_ids.description: Restrict Shopify revenue to these product IDs. Omit for the shop total. Values come from ``GET /halo/products``.

lag_days.title: Lag Days
lag_days.description: Shift TikTok views forward N days before correlating, to test a delayed halo (a video today, an Amazon order three days later). 0 correlates same-day. Sweep 0-14 and keep the strongest r.

HaloAnalysisRequest.title: HaloAnalysisRequest
HaloAnalysisRequest.description: POST /halo/analysis body — the window plus the lag to test.

channel_correlations.title: Channel Correlations
channel_correlations.description: Per-channel Pearson results for the off-platform channels only. TikTok GMV vs TikTok views is excluded — both are driven by the same activity, so it correlates by construction and is not halo.

branded_search_correlation.description: TikTok views vs branded-search volume. Null when untracked.

attribution.description: Raw revenue sums per channel for the window.

base_sales.title: Base Sales
base_sales.description: Average daily Amazon+Shopify revenue over the 30 days BEFORE the window — the pre-period run rate the window is measured against.

incremental_revenue.title: Incremental Revenue
incremental_revenue.description: Window revenue minus (``base_sales`` x days with data) — the revenue above the pre-period run rate. Negative means the window underperformed the baseline.

relationship_strength.title: Relationship Strength
relationship_strength.description: Pearson r between TikTok views and combined off-platform revenue at the requested lag. Null when fewer than 5 aligned day-pairs have data on both sides.

views_explain.title: Views Explain
views_explain.description: r-squared — the share of day-to-day revenue variance that moves with TikTok views. 0.42 reads as 'views explain ~42% of it'.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD).

asins.title: Asins
asins.description: Restrict to these ASINs. Omit for every tracked ASIN.

lag_days.title: Lag Days
lag_days.description: Shift TikTok views forward N days before correlating.

asins.title: Asins
asins.description: The ASIN filter applied, echoed back.

average_click_share.title: Average Click Share
average_click_share.description: Mean of the daily click-share values.

peak_date.title: Peak Date
peak_date.description: Date of the highest branded-search volume.

correlation.description: TikTok views vs branded search at the requested lag.

top_search_terms.title: Top Search Terms
top_search_terms.description: Always null. Amazon's report gives us branded-search VOLUME per ASIN per day, not the query strings, so no term list exists to return. Reserved so the field can be populated without a breaking change if term-level data is ever ingested.

branded_search.title: Branded Search
branded_search.description: Amazon branded-search rows exist for this shop.

amazon_has_data.title: Amazon Has Data
amazon_has_data.description: Amazon revenue rows exist. False while ``amazon`` is true means the connection is live but the first backfill is still running.

shopify_has_data.title: Shopify Has Data
shopify_has_data.description: Shopify revenue rows exist (same connected-vs-synced split).

p_value.title: P Value
p_value.description: Two-sided p-value, 6 dp. Below 0.05 is the usual bar.

amazon.title: Amazon
amazon.description: Null when Amazon was not requested.

shopify.title: Shopify
shopify.description: Null when Shopify was not requested.

dates.title: Dates
dates.description: Contiguous date axis; every series aligns.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 29 days before ``end_date`` (a 30-day window). Max window 366 days.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to yesterday — today's revenue rows have not been pulled yet.

amazon_asins.title: Amazon Asins
amazon_asins.description: Restrict Amazon revenue and branded search to these ASINs. Omit for the shop total. Values come from ``GET /halo/products``.

shopify_product_ids.title: Shopify Product Ids
shopify_product_ids.description: Restrict Shopify revenue to these product IDs. Omit for the shop total. Values come from ``GET /halo/products``.

HaloWindowRequest.title: HaloWindowRequest
HaloWindowRequest.description: Shared window + product-filter body for the halo POST reads.

website_url.title: Website Url
website_url.description: The brand's public website URL to scrape and analyse (e.g. https://www.thebean.com).

refresh.title: Refresh
refresh.description: Re-run the analysis even if a profile already exists for this URL.

ImageBriefCreateRequest.title: ImageBriefCreateRequest
ImageBriefCreateRequest.description: New image-brief draft. The shop comes from the API key, not the body.

product_ids.title: Product Ids
product_ids.description: Products to build the brief from; index 0 is the hero. At most 3.

status.title: Status
status.description: New lifecycle state, or omit to leave unchanged.

ImageBriefUpdateRequest.title: ImageBriefUpdateRequest
ImageBriefUpdateRequest.description: Partial update — only the fields you send are changed.

username.title: Username
username.description: The resolved IG handle, without the @.

profile_picture_url.title: Profile Picture Url
profile_picture_url.description: Meta-hosted avatar URL. These are short-lived signed URLs — re-fetch rather than storing them.

ig_user_id.title: Ig User Id
ig_user_id.description: The looked-up account's IG user ID (not this shop's).

data.title: Data
data.description: Up to 24 of the connected account's most recent IG posts, newest first. Each row carries `id`, `caption`, `media_type`, `media_url`, `thumbnail_url`, `permalink`, `timestamp`, `like_count` and `comments_count` as Meta returns them — the shape is passed through so new Graph fields appear without an API change.

status.title: Status
status.description: ``connected``, ``disconnected``, or ``coming_soon`` for an integration that isn't available to this shop yet.

connected_at.title: Connected At
connected_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the connection was established; null unless ``status`` is ``connected``.

IntegrationStatus.title: IntegrationStatus
IntegrationStatus.description: One integration's connection state for the shop.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: One row per integration offered to this shop.

qualifying_video_count.title: Qualifying Video Count
qualifying_video_count.description: DISTINCT video_id count for this creator across the selected products — a video spanning several selected products counts once.

LeaderboardCreatorItem.title: LeaderboardCreatorItem
LeaderboardCreatorItem.description: One creator's aggregated leaderboard row for the campaign window.

scoring_mode.title: Scoring Mode
scoring_mode.description: Rank by a single metric or by a weighted composite score

weighted_metrics.title: Weighted Metrics
weighted_metrics.description: Metric weights (must sum to 100) when scoring_mode is weighted

minimum_gmv_required.title: Minimum Gmv Required
minimum_gmv_required.description: Minimum GMV threshold (when metric includes gmv)

minimum_views_required.title: Minimum Views Required
minimum_views_required.description: Minimum views threshold (when metric is views)

minimum_videos_required.title: Minimum Videos Required
minimum_videos_required.description: Minimum videos floor (gmv_videos gate; ranking stays by GMV)

minimum_live_gmv_required.title: Minimum Live Gmv Required
minimum_live_gmv_required.description: Minimum LIVE GMV floor (when metric is live_gmv)

minimum_sessions_required.title: Minimum Sessions Required
minimum_sessions_required.description: Minimum LIVE sessions floor (weighted gate on a sessions weight)

LeaderboardPricing.title: LeaderboardPricing
LeaderboardPricing.description:
Pricing configuration for leaderboard campaigns.

Extra keys are IGNORED (the codebase default, matching every sibling
pricing class): the brand FE sends UI-only toggles like
``minimum_gmv_required_enabled`` that are not modelled here. The
smuggling protection the materializer needs comes from re-parsing the
stored template pricing through this model, which drops unknown keys so
they never reach a materialized instance — not from ``extra="forbid"``,
which would break the live create/edit path.

LeaderboardProductBreakdown.title: LeaderboardProductBreakdown
LeaderboardProductBreakdown.description:
One product's contribution to a creator's leaderboard row.

GMV/units are summed over the creator's qualifying video-product rows for
this product; video_count is the DISTINCT video_id count for this product.

LeaderboardRank.title: LeaderboardRank
LeaderboardRank.description: A single rank entry in a leaderboard campaign.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Compacted prize rank, 1-indexed. Null when the creator is disqualified by the campaign's minimum-activity requirement (unranked). Disqualified creators don't consume a prize place; tied creators share one (the following rank skips accordingly, e.g. 1, 1, 3), so each rank agrees with the prize it pays.

creator_id.title: Creator Id
creator_id.description: Reacher creator-account id. Null only for a legacy mapping row with no linked account.

handle.title: Handle
handle.description: Display handle: TikTok username, else full name, else `Creator`.

creator_name.title: Creator Name
creator_name.description: Creator's full name. Null when no name is on file.

composite_score.title: Composite Score
composite_score.description: 0-100 weighted composite. Null for single-metric campaigns (rank comes straight from `metric_type`).

score_breakdown.title: Score Breakdown
score_breakdown.description: Per-metric contribution breakdown. Null for single-metric campaigns.

gmv.title: Gmv
gmv.description: Video-attributed GMV in the shop currency. Meaning is unchanged by LIVE metrics — see `live_gmv`/`combined_gmv`.

live_gmv.title: Live Gmv
live_gmv.description: LIVE GMV attributed to this creator, restricted to the campaign's products. 0 for campaigns with no LIVE metric.

live_session_count.title: Live Session Count
live_session_count.description: In-window LIVE sessions that sold a campaign product.

combined_gmv.title: Combined Gmv
combined_gmv.description: `gmv + live_gmv`. The ranking value for the `gmv_and_live_gmv` and `videos_gmv_and_live_gmv` metrics.

frozen.title: Frozen
frozen.description: True when this standing is pinned by the campaign's locked board and can no longer change. False on a live board, and for a creator added after the lock (live values, listed after the locked standings).

LeaderboardStanding.title: LeaderboardStanding
LeaderboardStanding.description: A single creator's rank + score + per-metric stats in a campaign.

ListMembersResponse.title: ListMembersResponse
ListMembersResponse.description:
Includes the actual creator_handles + creator_emails. May be a long
payload; clients should expect tens of thousands of rows for big lists.

ListResource.title: ListResource
ListResource.description: A Lists row (vault_files). Used across all 4 automation types.

ranking_priority.title: Ranking Priority
ranking_priority.description: Primary ranking metric for sessions_and_live_gmv contests; the other is a per-tier requirement

LiveGMVChallengePricing.title: LiveGMVChallengePricing
LiveGMVChallengePricing.description: Pricing configuration for live GMV challenge campaigns.

videos_required.title: Videos Required
videos_required.description: Number of videos required for this tier

sessions_required.title: Sessions Required
sessions_required.description: Number of live sessions required for this tier (sessions_and_live_gmv metric)

LivePaymentTier.title: LivePaymentTier
LivePaymentTier.description:
A single tier in a live GMV challenge campaign.

Extends PaymentTier with ``sessions_required`` for the combined
sessions + live GMV gate.

LiveSessionProductBreakdown.title: LiveSessionProductBreakdown
LiveSessionProductBreakdown.description: One product sold inside one LIVE session.

live_session_ids.title: Live Session Ids
live_session_ids.description: LIVE session IDs to break down — the ``key`` field of a POST /lives/list row. Up to 50 per request.

LiveSessionProductsRequest.title: LiveSessionProductsRequest
LiveSessionProductsRequest.description:
Body for POST /lives/products.

Session IDs travel in the body rather than the path: ``live_session_id``
values are opaque and often all-numeric, and a numeric path segment is read
as a ``shop_id`` by the platform's shop-ownership middleware.

ctr.description: Click-through rate in percent (0-100). Converted to 0-1 in query layer.

engagementRate.description: Engagement rate in percent (0-100). Converted to 0-1 in query layer.

LivesFilters.title: LivesFilters
LivesFilters.description: Maps to the frontend filter sliders (ACU/PCU dropped — no data source).

account_type.title: Account Type
account_type.description: Which LIVE sessions to include: ``creator`` = affiliate creators' LIVEs (Affiliate Center creator LIVE-attributed GMV), ``own`` = the shop's own brand-account LIVEs (official LIVE GMV), ``all`` = both. Defaults to ``all``.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 29 days before ``end_date``.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

LivesListRequest.title: LivesListRequest
LivesListRequest.description:
POST /lives/list request body. Per-session LIVE rows for one shop,
paginated. Single shop only.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO currency code for the window; ``null`` when empty or mixed.

total.title: Total
total.description: Total number of LIVE sessions matching the window and ``account_type``.

pagination.description: Standard meta block (derived from page/page_size/total when omitted).

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: One entry per LIVE session on this page. Empty when the shop has no live-session data for the window (data-presence rollout — empty is a normal, non-error state).

LivesListResponse.title: LivesListResponse
LivesListResponse.description: Paginated per-session LIVE view for one shop, scoped by ``account_type``.

creator_handle.title: Creator Handle
creator_handle.description: Username hosting the LIVE (the brand's own handle when ``is_own_account``).

is_own_account.title: Is Own Account
is_own_account.description: True when the LIVE was hosted on the shop's own brand account.

start_time.title: Start Time
start_time.description: ISO 8601 UTC start of the LIVE session.

end_time.title: End Time
end_time.description: ISO 8601 UTC end of the LIVE session.

live_gmv.title: Live Gmv
live_gmv.description: LIVE GMV for this session: creator LIVE-attributed GMV for creator sessions, official LIVE GMV for own-account sessions.

viewers.title: Viewers
viewers.description: Unique viewers of this LIVE session.

ctr.title: Ctr
ctr.description: Click-through rate as a decimal 0.0–1.0 (stored value, else product_clicks / product_impressions).

engagement_rate.title: Engagement Rate
engagement_rate.description: Engagement rate as a decimal 0.0–1.0+ (stored value, else (likes+comments+shares) / views).

avg_viewing_duration.title: Avg Viewing Duration
avg_viewing_duration.description: Average viewing duration in seconds for this session.

LivesSessionItem.title: LivesSessionItem
LivesSessionItem.description: One LIVE session — an affiliate creator's or the shop's own account.

account_type.title: Account Type
account_type.description: Which LIVE sessions to include: ``creator`` = affiliate creators' LIVEs (Affiliate Center creator LIVE-attributed GMV), ``own`` = the shop's own brand-account LIVEs (official LIVE GMV), ``all`` = both. Defaults to ``creator`` so ``live_gmv`` equals the ``live_gmv`` metric on POST /metrics/*; pass ``own`` or ``all`` for brand-account LIVE totals.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 29 days before ``end_date`` (30-day window).

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today (live sessions can land same-day, unlike the Seller Center daily rollup).

LivesSummaryRequest.title: LivesSummaryRequest
LivesSummaryRequest.description:
POST /lives/summary request body. LIVE GMV window totals for one shop
(customers.live_sessions) — single shop, currency-aware.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO currency code applying to the window (e.g. 'USD', 'GBP'). ``null`` when the window has no live-session data or (defensively) when rows somehow mix currencies for the same shop.

live_count.title: Live Count
live_count.description: Number of LIVE sessions in the window.

live_gmv.title: Live Gmv
live_gmv.description: SUM of LIVE GMV across the window: creator LIVE-attributed GMV (Affiliate Center) for creator sessions, official LIVE GMV for the shop's own-account sessions.

items_sold.title: Items Sold
items_sold.description: SUM of units sold across the LIVE sessions.

avg_engagement_rate.title: Avg Engagement Rate
avg_engagement_rate.description: Window-level engagement rate as a decimal (0.0–1.0+): SUM(likes+comments+shares) / SUM(views). ``null`` when views are 0. Not the average of per-session rates.

avg_viewing_duration.title: Avg Viewing Duration
avg_viewing_duration.description: Average viewing duration in seconds across LIVE sessions; ``null`` when empty.

LivesSummaryResponse.title: LivesSummaryResponse
LivesSummaryResponse.description:
Window LIVE GMV totals (customers.live_sessions) for one shop, scoped
by ``account_type``. Single shop only; ``currency_code`` is per-shop.

MentionTarget.title: MentionTarget
MentionTarget.description: Who the announcement pings. `role` requires an explicit role_id.

body.title: Body
body.description: Message body (REQUIRED for type=message and type=text_with_image). Supports `{creator_name}` placeholder.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: Hosted HTTPS URL of the image (REQUIRED for type=image and type=text_with_image). Reacher fetches this URL server-side and re-hosts on the internal CDN — file uploads (multipart) are NOT accepted. Reject if `http://`, `data:`, `blob:`, or scheme-relative.

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: Product ID (REQUIRED for type=product_card; OPTIONAL for type=target_invite).

submission_url_slug.title: Submission Url Slug
submission_url_slug.description: Spark code form slug (REQUIRED for type=spark_code_form).

MessageAddon.title: MessageAddon
MessageAddon.description:
One element of a `messages[].addons` array — a single content block
inside a follow-up step. Polymorphic by `type`.

Per PR #1513 round-3 review (coderabbitai): each `type` has required
fields validated below. Without this, `{"type": "image"}` (no
image_url) slipped through and was persisted to the config blob,
leaving the runtime with an addon that advertised a type but had no
payload to render.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the shop's Meta ad account for the campaign's cents fields; null when no ad account is connected.

short_id.title: Short Id
short_id.description: 12-char slug used in the public creator join link.

status.title: Status
status.description: draft | active | paused

commission_base.title: Commission Base
commission_base.description: What the commission is a percentage of: 'attributed_revenue' (purchase conversion value from Meta insights) or 'ad_spend'; 'flat_fee_per_video' pays `flat_fee_cents` once per video instead.

commission_rate.title: Commission Rate
commission_rate.description: Percent, e.g. 3.0 = 3%. 0 on the flat_fee_per_video base.

commission_cap_cents.title: Commission Cap Cents
commission_cap_cents.description: Per-creator commission cap in cents, if set.

flat_fee_cents.title: Flat Fee Cents
flat_fee_cents.description: Amount paid once per video, in cents, when commission_base is 'flat_fee_per_video'; null otherwise.

usage_grant_on.title: Usage Grant On
usage_grant_on.description: Campaign requests a usage-rights grant from creators.

whitelist_grant_on.title: Whitelist Grant On
whitelist_grant_on.description: Campaign requests a Partnership-ads whitelist grant.

active_creators.title: Active Creators
active_creators.description: Distinct creators on the leaderboard (accepted/active roster plus cherry-picked media-library creators). Null unless the endpoint aggregates it (list endpoint).

commission_owed_cents.title: Commission Owed Cents
commission_owed_cents.description: Unpaid commission owed (ledger status pending+approved), cents. Null unless the endpoint aggregates it.

MetaAdsCampaignItem.title: MetaAdsCampaignItem
MetaAdsCampaignItem.description:
A Meta Ads rev-share campaign. The rollup fields (`active_creators`,
`attributed_revenue_cents`, `commission_owed_cents`) are populated on the
list endpoint and are null on endpoints that don't aggregate them.

creators.title: Creators
creators.description: One page of the ranked leaderboard.

creator_total.title: Creator Total
creator_total.description: Creators on the campaign across all pages, unaffected by search.

filtered_total.title: Filtered Total
filtered_total.description: Creators matching the request's search across all pages — the paging denominator. Equals creator_total when no search is set.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the shop's connected Meta ad account (all cents amounts are in this currency). Null when no ad account is connected or the currency is unknown.

MetaAdsCampaignRollupsResponse.title: MetaAdsCampaignRollupsResponse
MetaAdsCampaignRollupsResponse.description: Summary-card totals + ranked creator leaderboard for one campaign.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the shop's Meta ad account for the cents fields on each campaign; null when no ad account is connected.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Position on the whole leaderboard, assigned before any search filter — a filtered page keeps true board positions.

instagram_handle.title: Instagram Handle
instagram_handle.description: Normalized Instagram handle, when the creator stored one.

payout_earned_cents.title: Payout Earned Cents
payout_earned_cents.description: Lifetime commission earned across all ledger statuses, cents.

payout_outstanding_cents.title: Payout Outstanding Cents
payout_outstanding_cents.description: Unpaid portion only (ledger status pending+approved), cents.

payout_payable_cents.title: Payout Payable Cents
payout_payable_cents.description: The part of payout_outstanding_cents keyed by a TikTok account the creator is verified to own, cents — what a payout would actually transfer. Lower than outstanding when some earnings sit under a TikTok account not yet linked to this creator.

payout_status.title: Payout Status
payout_status.description: ready (payable money and a Stripe account to receive it) | awaiting_creator (payable money, creator has not connected Stripe) | awaiting_verification (earnings under a TikTok account not yet verified as this creator's) | paid (nothing outstanding).

whitelist_granted.title: Whitelist Granted
whitelist_granted.description: Partnership-ad whitelist status for this brand: true=approved, false=not approved, null=unknowable (creator has no linked Instagram).

whitelist_status.title: Whitelist Status
whitelist_status.description: Finer lifecycle: no_instagram | not_requested | pending | approved | revoked | unknown.

MetaAdsLeaderboardRow.title: MetaAdsLeaderboardRow
MetaAdsLeaderboardRow.description:
Per-creator row of the campaign leaderboard. One row per creator: a
creator the brand reached both by roster invite and by cherry-picking
their video into the media library is a single row, with the money from
both attribution keys.

asset_name.title: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Meta asset name. Ends with RCHR_{tracking_code}; anything before that is the shop's own naming template, so parse the code from tracking_code rather than from this string.

tracking_code.title: Tracking Code

Metric tiles for the Sample Requests header.

product-scoped number beside SKU-scoped ones is the divergence that got the
campaign filter reverted in CORE-6744. It is empty with no SKU filter.

gmv.description: **Affiliate-attributed** GMV for the period — Reacher's view of creator-driven sales. This is NOT the shop's full GMV. For the headline number that matches the customer's TikTok Seller Center dashboard (which includes ads / Smart+ and organic), use ``total_gmv`` or the dedicated ``POST /shop-gmv/*`` endpoints.

total_gmv.title: Total Gmv
total_gmv.description: **Full shop** GMV for the period — includes ads / Smart+ and organic revenue, not just affiliate-attributed sales. Sourced from the TikTok Seller Center scrape. Coverage is rolling out per-shop; shops not yet covered return ``0``. For per-day breakdown by channel (video / live / product_card) and explicit per-shop currency handling, use ``POST /shop-gmv/*`` instead.

live_gmv.title: Live Gmv
live_gmv.description: **Creator LIVE-attributed** GMV for the period — the value shops see on TikTok's Affiliate Center → LIVE streams (/insights/transaction-analysis). Sourced from ``customers.live_sessions`` (affiliate_gmv), a DIFFERENT source than ``gmv`` (all affiliate revenue) and ``total_gmv`` (full shop view). Isolates the LIVE-stream slice only. Coverage is data-presence driven; shops without live-session data return ``0``. Currency is per-shop — for the currency-aware, single-shop, per-session view use the dedicated ``POST /lives/*`` endpoints.

sc_affiliate_live_gmv.title: Sc Affiliate Live Gmv

Use this one to reconcile against a Seller Center export. It is NOT the same figure as ``live_gmv``, which comes from Affiliate Center and attributes revenue on transaction date rather than order date; the two will not match. Sourced from the same Seller Center daily rollup as ``total_gmv``, so the same caveats apply: coverage is rolling out per-shop and uncovered shops return ``0``, and currency is per-shop (multi-shop requests sum across currencies). For the per-day channel breakdown use ``POST /shop-gmv/*``.

Null means unknown — never zero. Present as a whole object or not at all, so a partial quota can never be mistaken for an unlimited one.

OutreachCapacityResponse.title: OutreachCapacityResponse
OutreachCapacityResponse.description:
Current outreach send-capacity for a single shop.

Two independent limits govern outreach (DM + TC) sends:

1. A **per-shop daily throttle** counted in UTC (resets at 00:00 UTC).
   `daily_creators_used` is the distinct (creator, automation) pairs the
   shop has reached today across all non-CRM, non-AI-Chatbot outreach
   automations. The *ceiling* is plan/TikTok-dependent and is not
   returned as a single number; `daily_limit_throttled` is true when any
   live automation is currently paused by the daily limit.
2. **TikTok's outreach quota**, enforced TikTok-side and read from
   TikTok's own quota endpoint — see `outreach_quota`, which carries the
   consumption, the ceiling, and the refresh instant for the current
   period. Most shops are on a weekly `PERIOD` quota; some hold a `BONUS`
   grant that does not roll, so check `outreach_quota.quota_type` before
   calling it weekly. `weekly_limit_throttled` is true when any live
   automation is currently paused by the limit.

   `outreach_quota` is null for a shop without the affiliate app
   authorized, or that has never synced — null means unknown, never zero.
   It is independent of `weekly_limit_throttled`: a throttled shop can
   still return null here, and its reset time is then unknown.

The daily throttle pool is **shared** between the automation engine and
direct `POST /target-collabs` invites — both draw from the same per-shop
daily figure.

quota_type.title: Quota Type
quota_type.description: `PERIOD` — the weekly allowance, refreshing at `resets_at`. `BONUS` — a standing grant that does NOT roll weekly; its `resets_at` can be far in the future. Do not present a BONUS quota as a weekly one.

used.title: Used
used.description: Creators consumed from the quota this period, as TikTok reports it. Counts connections shop-wide.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The ceiling. Null when the shop is unlimited — check `unlimited` rather than inferring from null. `0` is a real zero allowance. Always present (required) so an absent key can never be mistaken for an explicit null.

remaining.title: Remaining
remaining.description: Creators the shop can still reach this period: `max(0, limit - used)`. Null when the shop is unlimited.

unlimited.title: Unlimited
unlimited.description: True when the shop has no ceiling for this quota.

resets_at.title: Resets At
resets_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the quota refreshes, as declared by TikTok. For a BONUS quota this can be far future. Always present (required), nullable only if TikTok omitted it.

gmv_tier.title: Gmv Tier
gmv_tier.description: TikTok's granted GMV tier for this shop (e.g. "4", "5"). Same scale as `gmv_level` in the tier table.

gmv_level_rule.title: Gmv Level Rule
gmv_level_rule.description: TikTok's live tier table for the shop's region. Each entry maps a GMV level to its weekly outreach quota ceiling and follower cap.

OutreachQuota.title: OutreachQuota
OutreachQuota.description:
TikTok's outreach quota for a shop's current period.

Read from TikTok's own `/creator_outreach/quota` endpoint, not
reconstructed from Reacher's send tables — the two cannot agree, because
`used` counts connections shop-wide. It therefore includes outreach NOT
sent through Reacher, and excludes contact with creators the shop is
already connected to. Do not read it as "what Reacher sent".

units_on_refunded_lines.title: Units On Refunded Lines
units_on_refunded_lines.description: Units sitting on a line that carries a refund. A PARTIAL refund flags the whole line, so this is an upper bound on units returned — it is reported, never netted out, because whether a refunded unit still costs you is your accounting policy, not ours.

sample_units.title: Sample Units
sample_units.description: Sample sends in the window, from Reacher's own sample funnel. The Seller Center P&L export cannot supply this: free samples are not orders and never appear in it.

PnlProfitLines.title: PnlProfitLines
PnlProfitLines.description:
TikTok's bottom line carried down to a contribution profit.

Cost lines are negative like the rest of the P&L waterfall, so the three
lines above ``contribution_profit`` sum to it.

net_earnings.title: Net Earnings
net_earnings.description: TikTok's own bottom line for the window, from the daily series — the only source that includes GMV Max ad spend.

cogs.title: Cogs
cogs.description: Cost of goods on units sold. Negative, or 0.0 when unknown.

sample_cost.title: Sample Cost
sample_cost.description: Cost of samples sent. Negative, or 0.0 when unknown.

contribution_profit.title: Contribution Profit
contribution_profit.description: net_earnings + cogs + sample_cost. An UPPER BOUND whenever units_uncosted or sample_units_uncosted is non-zero — those units are counted as free, not guessed at.

units.title: Units
units.description: Units on order lines in the window.

units_uncosted.title: Units Uncosted
units_uncosted.description: Units with no COGS on file. Fill these in via PUT /pnl/costs.

units_on_refunded_lines.title: Units On Refunded Lines
units_on_refunded_lines.description: Units sitting on a line that carries a refund. A PARTIAL refund flags the whole line, so this is an upper bound on units returned — it is reported, never netted out, because whether a refunded unit still costs you is your accounting policy, not ours.

sample_units.title: Sample Units
sample_units.description: Sample sends in the window, from Reacher's own sample funnel. The Seller Center P&L export cannot supply this: free samples are not orders and never appear in it.

PnlProfitPoint.title: PnlProfitPoint
PnlProfitPoint.description: One bucket of the running cost-aware P&L.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD).

cadence.title: Cadence
cadence.description: `total` returns window totals only. Anything else also returns a bucketed series — the running P&L with costs applied.

sample_basis.title: Sample Basis
sample_basis.description: Which sample milestone the cost is charged against. `shipped` is when the unit physically leaves; use `approved` or `requested` if you accrue earlier.

PnlProfitRequest.title: PnlProfitRequest
PnlProfitRequest.description: POST /pnl/profit request body — TikTok's P&L less your own costs.

currency_mismatched_costs.title: Currency Mismatched Costs
currency_mismatched_costs.description: Cost rows skipped because they are priced in a different currency than the shop. Non-zero means some costs are silently absent.

units.title: Units
units.description: Units sold on this SKU's order lines in the window.

amounts.title: Amounts
amounts.description: Window SUMS of the requested fee columns for this SKU, keyed by TikTok's own column names — the same projection as `selected_fields`. Signs are TikTok's: gross sales positive, cost lines negative. `null` means TikTok sent no value for that column; an absent key means you did not request it. The `net_earnings` and `total_expense` columns, when requested, are the ORDER-LINE totals and therefore EXCLUDE ad spend — they are not this SKU's true net.

cogs.title: Cogs
cogs.description: Cost of goods on units sold this window. Negative, or 0.0 when no cost is on file.

gross_profit.title: Gross Profit
gross_profit.description: Contribution profit: the net earnings TikTok booked on this SKU's order lines, less COGS. EXCLUDES ad spend, so it is a gross / contribution figure, not the true bottom line. An UPPER BOUND while `units_uncosted` is non-zero, since uncosted units are counted as free rather than guessed at.

gross_margin_pct.title: Gross Margin Pct
gross_margin_pct.description: gross_profit as a percentage of gross sales. Null when gross sales is 0.

units_uncosted.title: Units Uncosted
units_uncosted.description: Units with no COGS on file. Fill these in via PUT /pnl/costs; gross_profit is an upper bound while this is non-zero.

PnlSkuRollup.title: PnlSkuRollup
PnlSkuRollup.description:
One SKU's P&L for the window: revenue and fees summed, less its COGS.

This is a GROSS / CONTRIBUTION view, not a net bottom line. The fee lines
are the ones TikTok books against the order itself (referral, affiliate
commission, refunds, discounts, and so on); ad spend is NOT among them
because TikTok does not attribute it to a single SKU. So ``gross_profit``
stops one step short of net earnings — for the true shop-level bottom line
that includes ad spend, use ``POST /pnl/summary`` and ``POST /pnl/profit``.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive paid-date window start (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive paid-date window end (YYYY-MM-DD).

amounts_fields.title: Amounts Fields
amounts_fields.description: Which fee columns each SKU's `amounts` carries, as window SUMS. `standard` (default) is the 12 lines a P&L waterfall needs; `full` is every column TikTok ships; or pass an explicit list of field names. Unknown names are rejected rather than ignored, so a typo cannot read as a zero fee. The resolved list comes back as `selected_fields`. Note: gross_profit is computed from a fixed internal set, so this selection changes only what is echoed, never the profit math.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Sort key, always descending, tie-broken by product_id then sku_id so paging is stable. `gross_sales` (default) surfaces top sellers, `gross_profit` top contributors, `units` highest volume.

PnlSkusRequest.title: PnlSkusRequest
PnlSkusRequest.description: POST /pnl/skus request body — per-SKU gross / contribution P&L.

total.title: Total
total.description: Distinct SKUs matching the window and filters, before paging.

selected_fields.title: Selected Fields
selected_fields.description: The fee columns every SKU's `amounts` carries, in canonical order — provenance for the projection you asked for, so an absent key reads as 'not requested' rather than 'no data'.

currency_mismatched_costs.title: Currency Mismatched Costs
currency_mismatched_costs.description: COGS rows skipped because they are priced in a different currency than the shop. Non-zero means some SKUs' COGS is silently absent, so their `gross_profit` is overstated and `units_uncosted` under-counts.

PnlSkusResponse.title: PnlSkusResponse
PnlSkusResponse.description: Per-SKU gross / contribution P&L for one shop.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 29 days before ``end_date``.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to yesterday — the current day is still accumulating.

PnlSummaryRequest.title: PnlSummaryRequest
PnlSummaryRequest.description: POST /pnl/summary request body — window totals as a P&L waterfall.

days_with_data.title: Days With Data
days_with_data.description: Daily rows that contributed to these totals.

rollups.title: Rollups
rollups.description: TikTok's own rollup columns, reported BESIDE the waterfall and deliberately not inside it. `total_marketing_cost` is exactly gmv_max + affiliate + campaigns + managed_services, so adding it as a waterfall line would double-count all four.

PnlSummaryResponse.title: PnlSummaryResponse
PnlSummaryResponse.description: Window totals for one shop as a P&L waterfall.

gmv_max.title: Gmv Max
gmv_max.description: GMV Max ad cost. Reliable at shop x day only — TikTok ships the per-order column empty, so per-SKU allocation needs GMV Max campaign data instead.

net_earnings.title: Net Earnings
net_earnings.description: TikTok's own bottom line for the window.

PnlTimeseriesPoint.title: PnlTimeseriesPoint
PnlTimeseriesPoint.description: One bucket of the running P&L series.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD).

cadence.title: Cadence
cadence.description: Bucket size. Buckets are summed from TikTok's own daily rows, so they reconcile to Seller Center exactly. Week and bi-weekly anchor on Monday.

PnlTimeseriesRequest.title: PnlTimeseriesRequest
PnlTimeseriesRequest.description: POST /pnl/timeseries request body — the running P&L series.

PnlTimeseriesResponse.title: PnlTimeseriesResponse
PnlTimeseriesResponse.description: Running P&L bucketed to the requested cadence.

gmv_max.title: Gmv Max
gmv_max.description: GMV Max ad cost. Reliable at shop x day only — TikTok ships the per-order column empty, so per-SKU allocation needs GMV Max campaign data instead.

net_earnings.title: Net Earnings
net_earnings.description: TikTok's own bottom line for the window.

PnlWaterfall.title: PnlWaterfall
PnlWaterfall.description:
P&L lines for a window, straight from TikTok's own daily series.

Signs are TikTok's: ``gross_sales`` is positive, cost lines are negative.
Costs the platform cannot know (COGS, sample cost, creator bonuses, agency
fees) are NOT represented here — those arrive with the cost-input layer.

PreviewWindowRequest.title: PreviewWindowRequest
PreviewWindowRequest.description:
POST /micro-challenges/preview-window -- draft schedule preview.

The FE posts its whole request object (which also carries ``shop_id``,
read from the query param) as the body — ``shop_id`` is declared so the
body validates; it is not used here.

snapshot_date.title: Snapshot Date
snapshot_date.description: Snapshot day; defaults to the latest stored snapshot for this metric.

version.title: Version
version.description: Collector run to page through, as returned in ``version`` by the first page. Pass it back on later pages, together with the ``snapshot_date`` the first page resolved, so a rerun between requests cannot duplicate, skip or silently empty the list; omitted = newest run.

ProblemsRequest.title: ProblemsRequest
ProblemsRequest.description: Body for ``/shop-health/problems`` — the items behind one metric on one snapshot.

shops_queried.title: Shops Queried
shops_queried.description: Shop names included when querying multiple shops (x-shop-id: all or comma-separated).

in_stock_only.title: In Stock Only
in_stock_only.description: When true, only products with total_inventory > 0.

updated_since.title: Updated Since
updated_since.description: Return only products Reacher synced on/after this instant. Accepts a plain date (YYYY-MM-DD, treated as midnight UTC) or a full ISO 8601 timestamp — pass the `updated_at` from a previous response verbatim to key an incremental catalog sync.

include_skus.title: Include Skus
include_skus.description: Embed the per-SKU inventory array on each product.

ProductCatalogRequest.title: ProductCatalogRequest
ProductCatalogRequest.description:
POST /products/catalog request body.

Merchandising catalog + current inventory (no date range), sourced from
product_catalog / product_catalog_sku. Distinct from ProductsListRequest,
which is affiliate performance over a date window.

seller.description: The seller's own video / live content.

ProductChannels.title: ProductChannels
ProductChannels.description: GMV attribution by the channel the sale came through.

ProductContextResponse.title: ProductContextResponse
ProductContextResponse.description: Resolved ProductRef[] for the poster header (name/brand/price/badges/image).

shops_queried.description: Shop names included when querying multiple shops (x-shop-id: all or comma-separated).

add_to_cart_rate.description: add_to_cart / clicks. Null when there were no clicks.

click_to_order_rate.description: orders / clicks. Null when there were no clicks.

sc_total_gmv.title: Sc Total Gmv

PublicProductConfigCreateRequest.title: PublicProductConfigCreateRequest
PublicProductConfigCreateRequest.description:
Create body — the portal's upsert body plus the product it applies to.

The portal keys product config by ``(shop_id, product_id)`` and takes the
product from the URL; the public surface exposes stable numeric config IDs
instead, so ``productId`` moves into the create body.

PublicQuotaUpdateRequest.title: PublicQuotaUpdateRequest
PublicQuotaUpdateRequest.description:
Quota update body.

Deliberately *not* the portal's ``QuotaSettingsRequest`` — that model takes
``shop_id`` in the body, which on a key-authenticated API would let a
caller aim the write at a shop the key doesn't own. The shop always comes
from the authenticated request here.

RaceMetric.title: RaceMetric
RaceMetric.description: The unit a Race funds. Each maps to a distinct candidate query.

RacePricing.title: RacePricing
RacePricing.description:
Shared prize pool, fixed value per qualifying unit, first come first served.

``extra="forbid"``: unlike the legacy types, whose frontend sends UI-only
toggles these models never declared, this is a new surface with no legacy
payload to tolerate. A misspelled or unsupported payout field must fail
loudly rather than be silently dropped -- which is also what makes the
minimum-floor rejection real rather than decorative.

RecommendedAction.title: RecommendedAction
RecommendedAction.description:
One recommended action shown in the Affiliate Report ("Affiliate
Summary").

Generation is currently rule-based — items are pulled from the same
top-N realtime queries the report itself uses, then templated into
actionable copy ("Send more samples to these top creators", "Replicate
these hooks in your next brief", "Prioritize sample budget for these
products"). The Pydantic shape is deliberately generic so a future
Gemini-backed implementation can swap in without FE / report-section
changes — see the docstring on get_recommended_actions for the
swap-point and how to wire the model call.

RecommendedActionItem.title: RecommendedActionItem
RecommendedActionItem.description: Single entity referenced by a recommended action (creator / video / product).

Recurrence.title: Recurrence
Recurrence.description:
The parsed ``recurrence`` JSONB column / API contract.

Parsed ONCE at the query-layer boundary (``parse_recurrence``) so a
malformed shape 400s at create time and can never blow up mid-dispatch.
``paused`` deliberately lives in its own column (the claim predicate must
match the partial index literally), so extra keys are ignored rather than
rejected — legacy rows carrying ``paused`` in the blob still parse.

message.title: Message
message.description: Optional custom message included in the creator's rejection email/SMS.

campaign_id.title: Campaign Id
campaign_id.description: Campaign (in the x-shop-id shop) to remove the creator from.

message.title: Message
message.description: Optional SMS sent to the creator on removal. Removal is otherwise silent (no email, no default SMS). Length capped at 320 to match the service's SMS limit. SKIPPED on X-Dry-Run.

RemoveCreatorRequest.title: RemoveCreatorRequest
RemoveCreatorRequest.description:
``POST /public/v1/campaigns/creators/{creator_id}/remove``.

Removes the creator from ONE campaign (terminal ``removed`` status).
The campaign's shop is the request's ``x-shop-id``; the campaign id
is the only required body field. Paid/completed creators are blocked
(409) to preserve their payout ledger.

code.title: Code
code.description: `ok` on a real removal; `already_removed` on an idempotent no-op replay of an already-removed mapping.

RemoveCreatorResponse.title: RemoveCreatorResponse
RemoveCreatorResponse.description:
200 response for ``POST /campaigns/creators/{creator_id}/remove``.

Mirrors the service envelope. ``code`` is ``"ok"`` on a real removal
and ``"already_removed"`` when the call was a no-op idempotent replay
of an already-``removed`` mapping (the service's internal
"invalid transition" 409 is translated to this 200 — see the route).
``data`` carries ``campaign_creator_mapping_id`` + ``status`` (always
``"removed"``).

window_days.title: Window Days
window_days.description: Recency window separating active from lapsed.

lookback_days.title: Lookback Days
lookback_days.description: Population window: creators with ≥1 post in this many days.

RepostBehaviorResponse.title: RepostBehaviorResponse
RepostBehaviorResponse.description: Repost behaviour of a shop's recent affiliates (CORE-6003).

RepostBucket.title: RepostBucket
RepostBucket.description: One repost-behaviour bucket and its size.

new_total_payout.title: New Total Payout
new_total_payout.description: New total payout — number for cash campaigns, string label (e.g. 'free product') for custom-reward campaigns.

RequestMoreContentRequest.description:
``POST /public/v1/campaigns/content/request-more`` — ask a creator

Mirrors ``community.schemas.content_request.RequestMoreContentRequest``
minus ``shop_id`` (header-injected).

ResolvedDateRange.title: ResolvedDateRange
ResolvedDateRange.description: The window the server actually used, after defaults were applied.

RestoreVideosRequest.title: RestoreVideosRequest
RestoreVideosRequest.description: Restore one or more previously excluded videos to a campaign.

payment_per_creator.title: Payment Per Creator
payment_per_creator.description: Payment amount (float for cash, str for custom)

minimum_gmv_required_enabled.title: Minimum Gmv Required Enabled
minimum_gmv_required_enabled.description: Whether minimum GMV requirement is active

minimum_views_required_enabled.title: Minimum Views Required Enabled
minimum_views_required_enabled.description: Whether minimum views requirement is active

payment_mode.title: Payment Mode
payment_mode.description: 'range' lets the brand set each creator's pay and videos on approval

seller_id.title: Seller Id
seller_id.description: The TikTok seller (brand) the video belongs to.

available.title: Available
available.description: True when a completed transcript is available for this video.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.description: Spoken-audio transcript text of the competitor video.

transcript_language.title: Transcript Language
transcript_language.description: BCP-47 language code the transcript was produced in.

SIVideoTranscriptResponse.description: The spoken-audio transcript of a Social Intelligence (competitor) video.

approved.title: Approved
approved.description: Deprecated: this is samples SHIPPED, not approved. Use `samples_shipped` for the same value or `samples_approved` for approvals.

samples_shipped.description: Samples shipped in the window (TikTok's count).
