videos_from_samples.description: Videos posted by creators who received a sample. Not the dashboard's Videos Posted, which counts every affiliate video for the product.

product_name.title: Product Name
product_name.description: Catalog name; falls back to the product_id when the catalog has no row.

requested.title: Requested
requested.description: Requests MADE on each day (the day's request cohort).

approved.title: Approved
approved.description: Approvals that HAPPENED on each day, whatever day the request was made.

shipped.title: Shipped
shipped.description: Shipments that HAPPENED on each day, whatever day the request was made.

SampleDailyProductItem.title: SampleDailyProductItem
SampleDailyProductItem.description:
One product row of the matrix: a count per day, per stage.

``requested`` / ``approved`` / ``shipped`` are aligned index-for-index with
the response's ``dates`` axis, zero-filled, oldest day first.

SampleDailyStageSources.title: SampleDailyStageSources
SampleDailyStageSources.description:
Where each stage's counts came from.

``seller_center`` is TikTok's own daily count, the number Seller Center and the
portal's Sample requests / Samples shipped cards show. ``applications`` counts
TikTok sample applications one by one; ``funnel_events`` is its fallback.

SampleDailyStageTotals.title: SampleDailyStageTotals
SampleDailyStageTotals.description: One product's window totals, per stage.

status.title: Status
status.description: Display status from rev_status_mapping()

bio.title: Bio
bio.description: Creator bio text. Sourced from the per-region creators table — the same field exposed by the AI Creator Search API. Null when the creator has no regional row.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Creator categories / niches. Parsed via the same helper the AI Creator Search API uses (handles JSON-array and comma-separated stored values). Null when the creator has no regional row.

email.title: Email
email.description: Creator contact email when known on the regional creators table. Null when the creator has no regional row or no email captured.

always_approve_status.title: Always Approve Status
always_approve_status.description: Auto-approve creators whose top-level `automation_status` matches this value (e.g. `APPROVED`, `LIVE_CREATOR`). Null = no status-based bypass.

always_approve_from_lists_ids.title: Always Approve From Lists Ids
always_approve_from_lists_ids.description: Vault list IDs whose members bypass criteria gates and are always approved.

SampleRequestAutoApprovalSettings.title: SampleRequestAutoApprovalSettings
SampleRequestAutoApprovalSettings.description:
Optional auto-approval gating beyond the min/max criteria.

  * `enabled=False` → manual review for every request that passes the
    performance gate. Other fields ignored.
  * `enabled=True` + `always_approve_status` set → auto-approve any
    creator whose `automation_status` matches; bypass criteria.
  * `total_weekly_approved_sample_limit` → hard ceiling on weekly
    auto-approvals across all creators (not per-product).
  * `always_approve_from_lists_ids` → approve members of these vault
    lists regardless of criteria.

Mirrors `sample_request_config.auto_approval_settings`.

engagement_rate.title: Engagement Rate
engagement_rate.description: Decimal 0-1 (e.g. 0.05 = 5%). Translator scales to 0-100 percent at persistence.

post_rate.title: Post Rate
post_rate.description: Decimal 0-1 (e.g. 0.5 = 50%). Translator scales to 0-100 percent at persistence.

creator_gmv_30_days.title: Creator Gmv 30 Days
creator_gmv_30_days.description: Creator GMV over the trailing 30 days.

gmv_per_sample.title: Gmv Per Sample
gmv_per_sample.description: GMV per sample sent — gates whether the creator's prior samples drove enough revenue.

shop_gmv.title: Shop Gmv
shop_gmv.description: Minimum creator GMV for this shop over the rolling 90 days. Mandatory for approval even with auto-approval shortcuts. Omit on PATCH to preserve the threshold; null explicitly clears it.

skip_ai_content_creators.title: Skip Ai Content Creators
skip_ai_content_creators.description: Approve action only: leave creators who post AI-generated content in To Review instead of approving them. A creator counts when TikTok labels 3 or more of their latest 10 posts AI-generated. They are never rejected, and creators on an always-approve list or an uploaded target list are still approved. Defaults to off. Null turns it off.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: `auto` (default): the automation approves/rejects on TikTok itself; with `video_screening` it approves under-the-line creators only when their videos qualify. `suggest`: it only scores pending requests and writes suggestions, which you review with `GET /samples/suggestions` and act on with `POST /samples/suggestions/approve` / `.../dismiss`. `suggest` requires `action='approve'`.

video_screening.description: Optional video-based screening (requires `action='approve'`). Creators below `screen_below_gmv_30d` are judged on their latest videos' analysed attributes: in `suggest` mode that produces a suggestion, in `auto` mode a qualifying creator is approved on TikTok (within the weekly caps) and anyone else is skipped. Replaces the stored block; null clears it.

SampleRequestPatchPayload.title: SampleRequestPatchPayload
SampleRequestPatchPayload.description:
All-Optional companion to `SampleRequestPayload` for PATCH bodies.
Reuses the create-time nested types (`SampleRequestProducts`,
`SampleRequestPerformanceCriteria`, `SampleRequestAutoApprovalSettings`)
which already have `extra="forbid"`.

approval_message.title: Approval Message
approval_message.description: DM body sent to the creator on approval. Only meaningful when action='approve' — rejected with reject. Persists as `sample_request_config.approval_message`.

rejection_message.title: Rejection Message
rejection_message.description: DM body sent to the creator on rejection. Only meaningful when action='reject'. Persists as `sample_request_config.rejection_message`.

message_images.title: Message Images
message_images.description: Optional HTTPS image URLs to attach to the approval / rejection DM. Same URL contract as MessageAddon.image_url — server fetches + re-hosts.

max_criteria_match.title: Max Criteria Match
max_criteria_match.description: Reject action only: how maximum thresholds combine. 'all' (the default for new automations) rejects a creator only when below every maximum threshold; 'any' rejects when below any one of them.

min_criteria_match.title: Min Criteria Match
min_criteria_match.description: Approve action only: how minimum criteria combine. 'all' (the default) approves a creator who meets every minimum criterion; 'any' approves one who meets at least one. Under 'all' the shop GMV criterion also gates the approval shortcuts; under 'any' it counts as one of the alternatives.

skip_ai_content_creators.title: Skip Ai Content Creators
skip_ai_content_creators.description: Approve action only: leave creators who post AI-generated content in To Review instead of approving them. A creator counts when TikTok labels 3 or more of their latest 10 posts AI-generated. They are never rejected, and creators on an always-approve list or an uploaded target list are still approved. Defaults to off.

target_list.title: Target List
target_list.description: List IDs (vault_files.resource_id, integer form). Required (≥1) — sample_request type uses target_list for creator selection, NOT creators_to_include.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: `auto` (default): the automation approves/rejects on TikTok itself; with `video_screening` it approves under-the-line creators only when their videos qualify. `suggest`: it only scores pending requests and writes suggestions, which you review with `GET /samples/suggestions` and act on with `POST /samples/suggestions/approve` / `.../dismiss`. `suggest` requires `action='approve'`.

video_screening.description: Optional video-based screening (requires `action='approve'`). Creators below `screen_below_gmv_30d` are judged on their latest videos' analysed attributes: in `suggest` mode that produces a suggestion, in `auto` mode a qualifying creator is approved on TikTok (within the weekly caps) and anyone else is skipped.

SampleRequestPayload.title: SampleRequestPayload
SampleRequestPayload.description:
Inner sample_request config — mirrors the legacy
`sample_request_config` shape exactly (the worker reads from it).

engagement_rate.title: Engagement Rate
engagement_rate.description: Decimal 0-1 (e.g. 0.05 = 5%). Translator scales to 0-100 percent at persistence.

post_rate.title: Post Rate
post_rate.description: Decimal 0-1 (e.g. 0.5 = 50%). Translator scales to 0-100 percent at persistence.

creator_gmv_30_days.title: Creator Gmv 30 Days
creator_gmv_30_days.description: Creator GMV over the trailing 30 days.

gmv_per_sample.title: Gmv Per Sample
gmv_per_sample.description: GMV per sample sent — gates whether the creator's prior samples drove enough revenue.

SampleRequestPerformanceCriteria.title: SampleRequestPerformanceCriteria
SampleRequestPerformanceCriteria.description:
Min/max performance gate for sample-request approval. All fields are
optional — omit a field to skip that side of the bound.

API contract uses unprefixed field names + decimal 0-1 scale for rates
(`engagement_rate=0.05` for 5%). The translator emits the V2 backend's
asymmetric prefix names + 0-100 percent scale at persistence. See
modules/automations/SampleRequestConfigModels.py for the V2 shape:
  - min side  → `min_followers`, `min_avg_views`, `min_engagement_rate`,
                `min_post_rate`, `min_creator_gmv_30_days`, `min_gmv_per_sample`
  - max side  → `maximum_followers`, `maximum_avg_views`,
                `maximum_engagement_rate`, `maximum_post_rate`,
                `maximum_creator_gmv`, `maximum_gmv_per_sample`

max_approvals_per_week.title: Max Approvals Per Week
max_approvals_per_week.description: Per-product weekly auto-approval cap. Matches the V2 backend field name (`SampleRequestConfigModels.SelectedProduct.max_approvals_per_week`); 0 = no auto-approvals for this product.

weekly_auto_approval_per_product.title: Weekly Auto Approval Per Product
weekly_auto_approval_per_product.description: Per-product weekly cap that applies to ALL shop products (only meaningful when `include_all_products=True`).

SampleRequestProducts.title: SampleRequestProducts
SampleRequestProducts.description:
Sample-request product targeting. Two modes:
  * `include_all_products=True` → all shop products eligible; supply
    `weekly_auto_approval_per_product` for the global per-product cap.
  * `include_all_products=False` → enumerate `selected_products` with
    per-product `max_approvals_per_week` caps.

Mirrors the legacy `sample_request_config.products` shape exactly so
FE-built and API-built automations are interchangeable to the worker.

gmv.title: Gmv
gmv.description: Creator lifetime GMV for this shop, in the shop's currency.

curr_status.title: Curr Status
curr_status.description: Current relationship/sample status for this creator.

sample_received_num.title: Sample Received Num
sample_received_num.description: How many samples this creator has already received.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Tags applied to this creator.

crm_found.title: Crm Found
crm_found.description: False when the creator has no CRM record yet — the aggregate fields are then null/empty and only the identity is populated.

SampleReviewCreatorAggregate.title: SampleReviewCreatorAggregate
SampleReviewCreatorAggregate.description: Creator-level aggregate for the header of the creator-videos response.

shop_id.title: Shop Id
shop_id.description: Optional. The shop is taken from the request's shop (x-shop-id). If given, shop_id must equal that shop or the call is rejected; omit it to use the shop already set on the request.

creator_id.title: Creator Id
creator_id.description: Creator id, scoped to the shop.

rank_by.title: Rank By
rank_by.description: Rank the creator's videos by lifetime GMV or lifetime views.

window_days.title: Window Days
window_days.description: Only videos posted within this many days back are considered.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Number of top videos to return (1-50).

include_full_features.title: Include Full Features
include_full_features.description: When true, also return the full scored-feature block per video (`uvi_full_features`) in addition to the curated recommended set.

currency_code.title: Currency Code
currency_code.description: ISO currency code for the shop's region (all GMV is in it).

field_guide.title: Field Guide
field_guide.description: Curated recommended fields and why each matters for sample review.

SampleReviewFieldGuideItem.title: SampleReviewFieldGuideItem
SampleReviewFieldGuideItem.description: One curated recommended field and why it matters for sample review.

hook_summary.title: Hook Summary
hook_summary.description: One-line description of how the video opens.

transcript_source.title: Transcript Source
transcript_source.description: Where the transcript came from: the analyzer, or the shop's transcript store used as a fallback.

on_screen_text.title: On Screen Text
on_screen_text.description: On-screen text (OCR), all segments joined. Null when there is none.

structure_outline.title: Structure Outline
structure_outline.description: Ordered beats of the video (e.g. Hook, Demo, CTA).

detected_products.title: Detected Products
detected_products.description: Products the analyzer recognised on screen.

vision_tags.title: Vision Tags
vision_tags.description: Visual tags detected in the video.

features.title: Features
features.description: Curated stable scored features: hook in the first three seconds, product demo present, solution shown, voiceover present, pace, and a content summary. Members the analyzer could not score are omitted.

SampleReviewUviRecommended.title: SampleReviewUviRecommended
SampleReviewUviRecommended.description:
The curated 'recommended for sample review' UVI fields.

Present only when the video has been analyzed. Individual members are null
when the analyzer had no value for them (e.g. a thumbnail-only analysis
carries no transcript); a null is 'not available', never a scored absence.

is_shoppable.title: Is Shoppable
is_shoppable.description: Whether the video has a shoppable (affiliate) leg. Null on legacy videos where the source is unknown.

uvi_analyzed.title: Uvi Analyzed
uvi_analyzed.description: False when the shop owns this video but the UVI pipeline has not analyzed it yet — `uvi_recommended` and `uvi_full_features` are then null. Coverage is partial and grows over time.

analyzed_at.title: Analyzed At
analyzed_at.description: When the UVI analysis ran. Null when unanalyzed.

analysis_version.title: Analysis Version
analysis_version.description: Analyzer version that produced the analysis.

uvi_recommended.description: The curated recommended UVI fields; null when unanalyzed.

uvi_full_features.title: Uvi Full Features
uvi_full_features.description: Only present with `include_full_features=true` on an analyzed video: the analyzer's full scored-feature block. Unstable across analyzer versions — pin the members you read.

SampleReviewVideo.title: SampleReviewVideo
SampleReviewVideo.description: One video's full composite: identity, internal metrics, and UVI analysis.

shop_id.description: Optional. The shop is taken from the request's shop (x-shop-id). If given, shop_id must equal that shop or the call is rejected; omit it to use the shop already set on the request.

video_id.title: Video Id
video_id.description: Video id, scoped to the shop.

include_full_features.title: Include Full Features
include_full_features.description: When true, also return the full scored-feature block (`uvi_full_features`) in addition to the curated recommended set.

currency_code.title: Currency Code
currency_code.description: ISO currency code for the shop's region (all GMV is in it).

field_guide.title: Field Guide
field_guide.description: Curated recommended fields and why each matters for sample review.

video_gmv.description: Total GMV attributed to this video, in the shop's currency.

shoppable_gmv.title: Shoppable Gmv
shoppable_gmv.description: GMV from the shoppable (affiliate) leg. Null on legacy videos that predate per-source GMV splitting.

official_gmv.title: Official Gmv
official_gmv.description: GMV from the Seller-Center (official) leg. Null on legacy videos that predate per-source GMV splitting.

SampleReviewVideoMetrics.title: SampleReviewVideoMetrics
SampleReviewVideoMetrics.description: Per-video internal metrics: GMV, views, and engagement counts.

shops_queried.title: Shops Queried
shops_queried.description: Shop names included when querying multiple shops (x-shop-id: all or comma-separated).

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: First day of the window (inclusive).

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Last day of the window (inclusive).

product_ids.title: Product Ids
product_ids.description: Restrict the matrix to these products. Omit for every product with sampling activity in the window.

SamplesDailyByProductRequest.title: SamplesDailyByProductRequest
SamplesDailyByProductRequest.description:
POST /samples/daily-by-product request body (CORE-7171).

Dates are REQUIRED: a per-day matrix over an unbounded window is not a
meaningful surface, and the dashboard refuses it for the same reason.
Windows longer than 92 days keep their LAST 92 days (the response says so
in ``clamped_to_days`` and echoes the served window in ``date_range``).

dates.title: Dates
dates.description: The day axis, YYYY-MM-DD, oldest first, in the shop's own timezone. Every per-day array aligns with it.

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: Per-day totals across EVERY in-scope product (not just this page), keyed by stage.

date_range.description: The window actually served, after any clamp.

clamped_to_days.title: Clamped To Days
clamped_to_days.description: Set to 92 when a longer window was clamped to its last 92 days; null otherwise.

stage_sources.description: Where each stage's counts came from; null when no window was read.

SamplesDailyByProductResponse.title: SamplesDailyByProductResponse
SamplesDailyByProductResponse.description:
Products × days sampling matrix for one shop (CORE-7171).

Same read as the portal's Sample-funnel matrix: days are the SHOP's calendar
days, not UTC's, and the stage semantics differ on purpose — ``requested``
counts the day's request cohort while ``approved`` / ``shipped`` count the
events that happened that day.

shops_queried.title: Shops Queried
shops_queried.description: Shop names included when querying multiple shops (x-shop-id: all or comma-separated).

status.title: Status
status.description: Filter by status. Accepts the labels returned in `status` (`Sample Requested`, `Sample Approved`, `Sample Shipped`, `Content Pending`, `Completed`, `Sample Rejected`, `Sample Request Expired`, `Sample Cancelled`, `Content Unfulfilled`, `Idle`), the pseudo-statuses `Posted Video`, `Sold Products`, `Showcasing Product`, `Livestreamed`, and the aliases `pending`, `approved`, `shipped`, `rejected`, `expired`, `cancelled`. Case-insensitive; an unrecognised value is rejected.

SaveListResponse.title: SaveListResponse
SaveListResponse.description: Response model for saving a creator list

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: This metric's weight (0-100). Weights across the campaign sum to 100.

contribution.title: Contribution
contribution.description: Weighted points this metric added to the composite (0-`weight`). Zero for everyone until a leader emerges on the metric.

raw_value.title: Raw Value
raw_value.description: The creator's raw metric value before normalization (e.g. GMV in the shop currency, view count).

ScoreBreakdownItem.title: ScoreBreakdownItem
ScoreBreakdownItem.description:
One metric's contribution to a creator's weighted composite score.

Present only for weighted leaderboards. ``contribution`` is
``weight/100 × (raw_value / top_performer_raw × 100)`` — the points
this metric added to the composite; the sum of every item's
``contribution`` equals the creator's ``composite_score``.

resolved.title: Resolved
resolved.description: Of those, how many resolved to a handle.

unresolved.title: Unresolved
unresolved.description: Matched creators with no resolvable handle — they cannot go into a creator list. Surfaced so the UI states the real audience size instead of quietly shipping a shorter one.

capped.title: Capped
capped.description: True when the segment hit the handle cap.

SegmentHandlesResponse.title: SegmentHandlesResponse
SegmentHandlesResponse.description: Handles behind a segment, for the create-automation handoff (CORE-6003).

days_with_data.title: Days With Data
days_with_data.description: Days in the window that had a Seller Center row for this product.

start_date.description: First day of the window (inclusive). Defaults to 30 days back.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Last day of the window (inclusive). Defaults to yesterday.

start_date.description: First day of the window (inclusive). Defaults to 30 days back.

end_date.description: Last day of the window (inclusive). Defaults to yesterday.

SellerCenterWindowRequest.title: SellerCenterWindowRequest
SellerCenterWindowRequest.description: Date window shared by the windowed Seller Center surfaces.

SendDraftDryRunResponse.title: SendDraftDryRunResponse
SendDraftDryRunResponse.description:
Shape for ``X-Dry-Run: true`` — the draft is resolved and ownership
checked so an agent can confirm it is about to send the right thing, but
TikTok is never contacted and the row is left in place.

SendDraftResponse.title: SendDraftResponse
SendDraftResponse.description: 201 — the draft was delivered and consumed.

SenderIdentity.title: SenderIdentity
SenderIdentity.description:
Who the announcement appears to come from.

The post is always made by the Reacher webhook; `member` only overrides the
webhook's display name + avatar for that one message (the APP badge stays).
`brand` = the shop name, which is also what a NULL sender means on the row.

On a request only `user_id` is trusted: the controller resolves it against
the linked guild and takes `display_name` / `avatar_url` from Discord, so a
caller cannot persist a fabricated identity.

content.title: Content
content.description: Exact rendered text as sent (placeholders substituted)

status.title: Status
status.description: Send-log role, e.g. BOT_INITIAL_MESSAGE / follow-up statuses

exact_copy.title: Exact Copy
exact_copy.description: True — DM copy is the rendered per-creator sent text

message.title: Message
message.description: Explicit empty state when nothing was sent

exact_copy.title: Exact Copy
exact_copy.description: False — TC per-creator rendered copy is not stored; template is the sent copy

total_invitations.description: Batches with a sent status (NEW_INVITATION / EDITED_INVITATION); excludes skipped/failed.

total_creators_invited.title: Total Creators Invited
total_creators_invited.description: Creators across sent-status batches only. See status_breakdown for skipped/failed.

status_breakdown.description: Batch count per target_collabs status across ALL rows (sent, skipped=PREVIOUS_INVITATION, INVALID_CREATORS, etc.).

campaign.description: Campaign linked via campaigns.tc_automation_id, when one exists

message.title: Message
message.description: Explicit empty state when nothing was sent

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Relative window ending at the shop's newest settled day: ``<n>d`` (1-999), ``<n>m`` (1-99) or ``all``, always capped at 365 days. Mutually exclusive with explicit dates; defaults to ``30d`` when neither is given.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD).

granularity.title: Granularity
granularity.description: ``day`` returns one point per day; ``week`` sums Sunday-start weeks.

SeriesRequest.title: SeriesRequest
SeriesRequest.description: Body for the two shop-performance series endpoints.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Settlement amount in the campaign's currency. Capped at $100,000 per call as a sanity guard.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. 'USD'). **Informational** — the shop's persisted wallet currency takes precedence at settlement time. If the wallet currency differs from this value, the transfer executes in the wallet currency without rejection. The response's ``currency`` field confirms the currency actually used for the transfer.

reward_type.title: Reward Type
reward_type.description: 'cash' triggers a Stripe transfer + wallet debit; 'custom' records the settlement only (no money moves).

campaign_creator_mapping_id.title: Campaign Creator Mapping Id
campaign_creator_mapping_id.description: REQUIRED. The campaign-creator mapping id that the settlement is being recorded against. The portal surfaces this id on every creator row in ``GET /campaigns/{id}/detail`` and in the response to the accept endpoint, so callers always have it. Required because the underlying ``PaymentService.settle`` only runs its double-payment guard (``claim_for_settlement_sync``) when a mapping id is present — omitting it would leave the money-moving path with idempotency-only protection (a different ``Idempotency-Key`` per call could debit the wallet repeatedly with no DB-level guard).

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Free-form metadata stored alongside the settlement (e.g. agent annotation, internal reference).

SettlePaymentRequest.title: SettlePaymentRequest
SettlePaymentRequest.description:
``POST /public/v1/campaigns/payments/settle`` — pay a creator out.

Triggers a **real Stripe transfer + wallet debit** when
``reward_type='cash'``; ``reward_type='custom'`` records the
settlement only (no money moves). Idempotency-Key is REQUIRED and
the inner ``PaymentService.settle`` runs claim/release semantics
so a retry with the same key can never double-pay.

transfer_id.title: Transfer Id
transfer_id.description: Stripe transfer id for cash settlements. Null for custom-reward settlements (no Stripe call).

wallet_balance.title: Wallet Balance
wallet_balance.description: Remaining wallet balance after the settlement.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Metric keys to show, in display order

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.description: Dashboard tabs the viewer can open: overview, creators, videos, sample_funnel. Omitted means Overview only.

sample_counts.title: Sample Counts
sample_counts.description: Show sample counts (requested, shipped, approved, posted) on the Sample Funnel tab. Off unless the owner turns it on.

ShareReportConfig.title: ShareReportConfig
ShareReportConfig.description:
Which metric cards and modules a share link shows an external viewer.

An omitted/empty config is meaningful: it marks a legacy link, which renders
the original fixed six-card layout. That is why ``metrics`` and ``modules``
default to None rather than to empty collections — "no opinion" and "the
owner turned everything off" must stay distinguishable.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password the viewer must enter. At least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit — or 12+ characters as a passphrase.

locked_start_date.title: Locked Start Date
locked_start_date.description: Start of a fixed reporting window (with locked_end_date).

locked_end_date.title: Locked End Date
locked_end_date.description: End of a fixed reporting window (with locked_start_date).

report_config.description: Which metric cards and modules the viewer sees. Omit for the legacy fixed layout. Outreach-volume metrics are rejected — a share link may not disclose automation scale.

SharedDashboardCreateBody.title: SharedDashboardCreateBody
SharedDashboardCreateBody.description:
A new password-protected share link for the caller's shop.

``shop_id`` is deliberately not a body field — the shop comes from
``x-shop-id``. Accepting a second, ignorable copy would let a caller believe
they had scoped a link that they had not.

SharedDashboardDeleteResponse.title: SharedDashboardDeleteResponse
SharedDashboardDeleteResponse.description: Result of archiving a share link.

data.title: Data
data.description: One entry per shop that has a share link. May be empty.

SharedDashboardListResponse.title: SharedDashboardListResponse
SharedDashboardListResponse.description: Every share link the API key can see.

status.title: Status
status.description: `active` or `inactive`. Use DELETE to archive.

clear_lock.title: Clear Lock
clear_lock.description: Remove the locked window entirely. Cannot be combined with a locked date range — omitted dates mean 'leave it alone', so this flag is how you say 'unlock'.

report_config.description: Updates the fields you send (metrics, modules, tabs); fields you omit keep their current values, so a password-only change never wipes them.

SharedDashboardUpdateBody.title: SharedDashboardUpdateBody
SharedDashboardUpdateBody.description: Partial update for one share link. Omitted fields are left alone.

days_expected.title: Days Expected
days_expected.description: Days of this bucket inside the window and on or before the settled day.

is_complete.title: Is Complete
is_complete.description: True only when the whole bucket is settled, every expected day has a row, and no core metric is missing on any of them.

currency_code.title: Currency Code
currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code. ``USD`` when present — the official TikTok API normalises all amounts to US dollars. ``null`` when the window has no data.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Per-product order lines (not unique checkouts). A single checkout with 3 SKUs counts as 3 here. Use ``ShopPerformancePoint.orders`` for the unique-checkout count.

is_walk_complete.title: Is Walk Complete
is_walk_complete.description: Whether the collector's product walk covered every page.

currency_code.title: Currency Code
currency_code.description: Null when the window mixes currencies; points carry their own.

latest_available_date.title: Latest Available Date
latest_available_date.description: Newest stored day for this shop, or null when nothing is stored.

earliest_available_date.title: Earliest Available Date
earliest_available_date.description: Oldest stored day for this shop, or null when nothing is stored. A prior-period comparison is only meaningful when the prior window starts on or after this day.

status.title: Status
status.description: The shop's plan tier (active, pro, inactive, ...).

is_collecting.title: Is Collecting
is_collecting.description: True when the shop is logged in and no failure is recorded — i.e. empty results from other endpoints mean 'no activity', not 'collection stopped'.

is_logged_in.title: Is Logged In
is_logged_in.description: Whether Reacher's TikTok session for this shop is live.

is_banned.title: Is Banned
is_banned.description: True when TikTok has banned the shop's account.

failure_reason.title: Failure Reason
failure_reason.description: Why the connection failed, or null when healthy. One of: banned, account_dead, shop_punished, permission_denied, affiliate_access_missing, seller_account_mismatch, region_not_set, login_issue.

onboarding_status.title: Onboarding Status
onboarding_status.description: Onboarding stage: onboard_pending, alias_created, added_to_affiliate_portal, onboard_complete, onboarding_failed.

detected_region.title: Detected Region
detected_region.description: Region inferred from the shop's activation link. May be a region Reacher does not operate in — that is the point of the field.

region_supported.title: Region Supported
region_supported.description: True when the shop's region is one Reacher operates in, false when it is not, null when there is no region signal yet.

last_login_time.title: Last Login Time
last_login_time.description: When Reacher last established a session for this shop.

ShopConnectionHealthResponse.title: ShopConnectionHealthResponse
ShopConnectionHealthResponse.description: Connection / data-collection health for one shop.

gmv.title: Gmv
gmv.description: Total live-attributed GMV for the day.

seller.title: Seller
seller.description: Live GMV from the seller's own lives.

ShopGmvLiveChannel.title: ShopGmvLiveChannel
ShopGmvLiveChannel.description: Live-attributed GMV breakdown for a single time point.

shop_tab.title: Shop Tab
shop_tab.description: GMV from customers browsing the shop tab/storefront.

ShopGmvProductCardChannel.title: ShopGmvProductCardChannel
ShopGmvProductCardChannel.description: Product-card (organic) GMV breakdown for a single time point.

gmv.title: Gmv
gmv.description: Total GMV for the day (before tax, excl. platform co-funding). Sum of channels ≈ gmv (small residuals possible).

aov.title: Aov
aov.description: Average order value for the day.

ShopGmvSeriesPoint.title: ShopGmvSeriesPoint
ShopGmvSeriesPoint.description: One day in the shop-GMV time series.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 29 days before ``end_date``.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to yesterday.

ShopGmvSummaryRequest.title: ShopGmvSummaryRequest
ShopGmvSummaryRequest.description:
POST /shop-gmv/summary request body. Window totals across the
Seller Center daily rollup for one shop.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO currency code; ``null`` when window has no data.

day_count.title: Day Count
day_count.description: Number of daily rows that contributed to these totals.

gmv.title: Gmv
gmv.description: SUM of daily GMV across the window.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: SUM of daily unique checkout orders (one per transaction, regardless of SKU count). This matches the Seller Center 'Orders' metric, not the per-product line count.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: SUM of daily unique-customer counts. NOTE: this double-counts buyers who purchased on multiple days; the source rollup is unique-per-day. A true window-distinct count is not derivable from this table.

aov.title: Aov
aov.description: Window-level AOV computed as total GMV / total orders over the window. ``null`` when there are no orders. Note: this is NOT the average of daily AOV values (which would be meaningless since daily AOVs have different denominators).

channels.description: SUMmed channel breakdown across the window.

ShopGmvSummaryResponse.title: ShopGmvSummaryResponse
ShopGmvSummaryResponse.description: Window totals across the Seller Center daily rollup for one shop.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 29 days before ``end_date`` (30-day window). The Seller Center data is back-filled ~90 days per shop, so older ranges will return an empty series.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to yesterday (today is excluded because the daily row is still incomplete).

ShopGmvTimeseriesRequest.title: ShopGmvTimeseriesRequest
ShopGmvTimeseriesRequest.description:
POST /shop-gmv/timeseries request body. Full Seller Center shop GMV
(ads + organic + affiliate) — single shop, daily grain.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO currency code applying to every point in the series (e.g. 'GBP', 'USD'). ``null`` when the series is empty or (defensively) when the source rows somehow mix currencies for the same shop — in that case GMV values should not be summed in the client.

series.title: Series
series.description: One entry per day with data in the window. Empty when the shop has no Seller Center data for this range (collection is rolling out — empty is a normal, non-error state).

ShopGmvTimeseriesResponse.title: ShopGmvTimeseriesResponse
ShopGmvTimeseriesResponse.description:
Daily shop-GMV time series from the Seller Center scrape. Single
shop only; ``currency_code`` is per-shop and applies to every point.

gmv.title: Gmv
gmv.description: Total video-attributed GMV for the day.

seller.title: Seller
seller.description: Video GMV from the seller's own videos.

ShopGmvVideoChannel.title: ShopGmvVideoChannel
ShopGmvVideoChannel.description: Video-attributed GMV breakdown for a single time point.

status.title: Status
status.description: EXCELLENT / GOOD / POOR / CRITICAL / NIL.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Percentage weight of this dimension in the overall SPS.

ShopHealthDimension.title: ShopHealthDimension
ShopHealthDimension.description:
One dimension of the Shop Performance Score breakdown — a high-level
grouping such as "Product satisfaction", "Fulfillment and logistics", or
"Customer service" (verified live: TikTok returns these three).

ShopHealthLatestRequest.title: ShopHealthLatestRequest
ShopHealthLatestRequest.description:
POST /shop-health/latest request body. Returns the most recent SPS
snapshot for the shop — takes no parameters.

snapshot.description: Most recent SPS snapshot, or ``null`` if the shop has no SPS data yet.

ShopHealthLatestResponse.title: ShopHealthLatestResponse
ShopHealthLatestResponse.description: The most recent Shop Performance Score snapshot for one shop.

snapshot_count.title: Snapshot Count
snapshot_count.description: Distinct snapshot days in the window.

ShopHealthPoint.title: ShopHealthPoint
ShopHealthPoint.description: A single daily Shop Performance Score snapshot.

snapshot_date.title: Snapshot Date
snapshot_date.description: Resolved snapshot day; null when none is stored.

upstream_total.title: Upstream Total
upstream_total.description: TikTok's own count of problem items for this metric.

version.title: Version
version.description: Collector run the items come from; pass back as ``version`` for later pages.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 29 days before ``end_date`` (30-day window). Max window 90 days.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to yesterday (today's snapshot is not recorded until the daily pull runs).

ShopHealthTimeseriesRequest.title: ShopHealthTimeseriesRequest
ShopHealthTimeseriesRequest.description:
POST /shop-health/timeseries request body. Daily Shop Performance Score
(SPS) trend for one shop.

series.title: Series
series.description: One entry per day with a recorded snapshot. Empty when the shop has no SPS history for this range (only official-API shops are covered, and history builds from the first daily pull — empty is a normal, non-error state).

ShopHealthTimeseriesResponse.title: ShopHealthTimeseriesResponse
ShopHealthTimeseriesResponse.description:
Daily Shop Performance Score (SPS) trend for one shop. Sourced from
TikTok's official /analytics/202606/shop_performances/overview.

ShopOverviewComparison.title: ShopOverviewComparison
ShopOverviewComparison.description: TikTok's own comparison-period totals, summed across the window.

days_expected.title: Days Expected
days_expected.description: Days of this bucket inside the window and on or before the settled day.

is_complete.title: Is Complete
is_complete.description: True only when the whole bucket is settled, every expected day has a row, and no core metric is missing on any of them.

currency_code.title: Currency Code
currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code. ``USD`` when present — the official TikTok API normalises all amounts to US dollars. ``null`` when the window has no data.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Unique checkout orders (one per transaction, regardless of how many SKUs are in the cart). Compare with ``sku_orders`` for the per-product line count.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Buyers per day as TikTok reports them; weekly buckets sum the days, so a repeat buyer counts each day.

currency_code.title: Currency Code
currency_code.description: Null when the window mixes currencies; points carry their own.

latest_available_date.title: Latest Available Date
latest_available_date.description: Newest stored day for this shop, or null when nothing is stored.

earliest_available_date.title: Earliest Available Date
earliest_available_date.description: Oldest stored day for this shop, or null when nothing is stored. A prior-period comparison is only meaningful when the prior window starts on or after this day.

product_name.title: Product Name
product_name.description: Null when the product catalogue has no name for it.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: First cover image from the product catalogue, if any.

days_observed.title: Days Observed
days_observed.description: Days in the window on which TikTok listed the product.

listing_status.title: Listing Status
listing_status.description: From the product catalogue: live, out_of_stock, seller_deactivated, platform_deactivated or rejected; null when the catalogue does not know the product or its status code, or when listing_data_available is false.

shop_tab_gmv.title: Shop Tab Gmv
shop_tab_gmv.description: Overlaps the four channels; not part of the sum.

other_gmv.title: Other Gmv
other_gmv.description: gmv minus the four exclusive channels.

ShopProductChannelRow.title: ShopProductChannelRow
ShopProductChannelRow.description: One product summed over the window, from TikTok's daily product list, with its GMV and orders by channel.

currency_code.title: Currency Code
currency_code.description: Null when the products mix currencies.

page.title: Page
page.description: The page these products are on; ``limit`` per page.

product_total.title: Product Total
product_total.description: Distinct products TikTok listed in the window, across all pages.

listing_data_available.title: Listing Data Available
listing_data_available.description: False when the product catalogue could not be read for this response: nothing was excluded and every listing_status and price is null.

affiliate_market_region.title: Affiliate Market Region
affiliate_market_region.description: Marketplace a cross-border (region `GLOBAL`) shop sells in, as a TikTok region code (e.g. `GB`, `DE`, `IT`). Null for region-scoped shops, whose `region` is the marketplace, and for cross-border shops created before the marketplace was recorded.

business_region.title: Business Region
business_region.description: Where a cross-border (region `GLOBAL`) shop's business is registered: `CN`, `HK`, `US` or `EU`. Decides which TikTok cross-border seller center the shop signs in on. Null for region-scoped shops and for cross-border shops created before it was asked.

customer_id.title: Customer Id
customer_id.description: The customer (brand account) that owns this shop. Most useful on the internal master-key cross-customer shop listing, where results span multiple brands.

primary_category.title: Primary Category
primary_category.description: Shop's primary L1 product category from TikTok Shop. Matches one of the canonical L1 names returned by GET /api/social-intelligence-v2/sellers/categories. Null when the shop has no Social Intelligence data yet.

email.title: Email
email.description: Default contact email shown to the creator on the TC card.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Optional default contact phone. E.164 format recommended.

ShopSupportContactDefaultRequest.title: ShopSupportContactDefaultRequest
ShopSupportContactDefaultRequest.description:
Body for PUT /public/v1/target-collabs/support-contact-default (CORE-5428).

Sets the shop-level default TC support contact. `email` is required;
`phone` is optional (TikTok's TC card accepts an email-only contact).
Validation mirrors `TargetCollabContact` so a stored default always
satisfies the TC create surfaces it falls back into.

configured.title: Configured
configured.description: True when a default is stored for this shop. When False, TC create requests must supply `support_contact` per request.

email.title: Email
email.description: Default contact email, or null when not configured.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Default contact phone, or null when unset/not configured.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last update, or null when not configured.

ShopSupportContactDefaultResponse.title: ShopSupportContactDefaultResponse
ShopSupportContactDefaultResponse.description:
Shop-level default TC support contact (CORE-5428).

Returned by GET and PUT /public/v1/target-collabs/support-contact-default.
`configured` is False (and email/phone/updated_at are null) when the shop
has no default set — in that state the TC create surfaces still require a
per-request `support_contact`.

windowDays.title: Windowdays
windowDays.description: The window the figures were computed over.

windowEnd.title: Windowend
windowEnd.description: ISO instant the window closes on: the creator's most recent shop post, not the time of the request. `windowDays` counts back from here, so a creator who last posted a month ago still reports their latest activity rather than an empty week. Null when we hold no dated video for them, in which case `performance` covers their whole history rather than a window.

brandName.title: Brandname
brandName.description: Shop name, falling back to the seller id.

logoUrl.title: Logourl
logoUrl.description: Store icon URL. Empty string when we hold no icon.

latestVideoAt.title: Latestvideoat
latestVideoAt.description: ISO timestamp of their newest video for this brand.

SiCreatorBrandItem.title: SiCreatorBrandItem
SiCreatorBrandItem.description: One brand a creator has posted for, over the requested window.

total.title: Total
total.description: Brands in the window, not just the rows on this page.

shopPosts.title: Shopposts
shopPosts.description: Shop videos posted in the window.

engagement.title: Engagement
engagement.description: Interactions per hundred views over the window — likes, comments and shares divided by plays.

followers.title: Followers
followers.description: Latest follower count. Does not vary with the window.

SiCreatorPerformance.title: SiCreatorPerformance
SiCreatorPerformance.description:
One creator's output over the requested window.

Every figure here is summed from the creator's shop videos over the same
window, rows and anchor the `/brands` and `/videos` endpoints use, so the
brand rows add up to `gmv` (CORE-8265). `followers` is the exception: a
point-in-time count, not a window figure.

data.title: Data
data.description: Export rows, one object per record.

row_limit.title: Row Limit
row_limit.description: Per-request row cap applied. Null when the customer is uncapped.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True when the row cap clipped the result — there is more data than was returned. Narrow the filters and export again rather than treating the rows as the complete set.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Column order used by the CSV form.

SiExportResponse.title: SiExportResponse
SiExportResponse.description: JSON form of an SI export. `format=csv` returns a CSV file instead.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Relative window ending at the shop's newest settled day: ``<n>d`` (1-999), ``<n>m`` (1-99) or ``all``, always capped at 365 days. Mutually exclusive with explicit dates; defaults to ``30d`` when neither is given.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD).

metric_codes.title: Metric Codes
metric_codes.description: Restrict to these metric codes; all six when omitted.

SnapshotRequest.title: SnapshotRequest
SnapshotRequest.description: Body for ``/shop-health/metrics`` — every stored SPS metric snapshot in the window.

creator_id.title: Creator Id
creator_id.description: TikTok creator ID. Null on a bulk-uploaded retainer code, which carries only the handle its uploader typed.

creator_handle.title: Creator Handle
creator_handle.description: TikTok handle from the CRM roster, or the handle supplied in a bulk upload. Null for a creator with no CRM row yet.

automation_id.title: Automation Id
automation_id.description: The automation whose form collected it. Null for scraped and bulk-uploaded codes.

form_uuid.title: Form Uuid
form_uuid.description: The form the creator submitted — the UUID in the `/spark-code-form/{form_uuid}` link they were DMed.

permission.title: Permission
permission.description: The creator ticked the permission box on the form. NOT a usage-rights grant — usage rights are a separate flow with their own lifecycle.

source.title: Source
source.description: `form`, `scraped`, or `bulk_upload` — where the code came from.

collected_at.title: Collected At
collected_at.description: When the code was submitted, scraped, or uploaded (ISO 8601).

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Authorisation expiry (ISO 8601). Null when the source does not carry one.

SparkCodeSyncAllRequestPublic.title: SparkCodeSyncAllRequestPublic
SparkCodeSyncAllRequestPublic.description:
``POST /public/v1/gmv-max/spark-codes/sync-all`` — queue every
unsynced code for the shop. Returns immediately with a queue count;
the offline CRJ actually fires the TikTok calls.

Has no body fields (shop_id comes from `x-shop-id`); kept as a model
so we can still ``extra="forbid"`` against accidental payloads.

spark_codes.title: Spark Codes
spark_codes.description: Up to 100 spark codes to sync in one request. Each code fires one TikTok `/tt_video/authorize/` call; rate-limited codes are left as `pending` so the offline CRJ picks them up. Whitespace is stripped; blank or duplicate entries are rejected with 422.

SparkCodeSyncRequestPublic.title: SparkCodeSyncRequestPublic
SparkCodeSyncRequestPublic.description:
``POST /public/v1/gmv-max/spark-codes/sync`` — sync specific codes
immediately. Calls TikTok synchronously and returns per-code results.

StageProductRow.title: StageProductRow
StageProductRow.description: One row in the per-stage product aggregates response.

suggestion_ids.title: Suggestion Ids
suggestion_ids.description: Suggestions to approve (max 50). Omit when using `all_qualifying`.

all_qualifying.title: All Qualifying
all_qualifying.description: Approve every `suggested` + `qualifies` suggestion (best-ranked first, up to 50 per call — call again for more). Mutually exclusive with `suggestion_ids`.

approved.title: Approved
approved.description: Approved on TikTok (or would be, on a dry run).

dismissed.title: Dismissed
dismissed.description: Dismissed (or would be, on a dry run).

suggestion_ids.title: Suggestion Ids
suggestion_ids.description: Suggestions that were (or would be) actioned.

preference_score.title: Preference Score
preference_score.description: 0-1, higher ranks first among qualifying creators.

summary.description: Counts per verdict for the requested status (ignores `verdict`).

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Null when it could not be evaluated.

SummaryResponse.title: SummaryResponse
SummaryResponse.description:
One-shot dashboard payload — populates the FE's connected state in
a single request without repeatedly polling /status + IG endpoints.

Each sub-object is open-schema (extra="allow") so we can add fields
without breaking existing FE consumers.

SweepstakesPricing.title: SweepstakesPricing
SweepstakesPricing.description:
Points buy entries; one winner drawn weighted by points share.

See RacePricing for why extra="forbid".

invitation_name.title: Invitation Name
invitation_name.description: Name shown on the TC invitation card (max 30 chars). Required by the portal — without it, the card displays empty. Persists as `config.BASE_INVITATION_NAME`.

valid_until.title: Valid Until
valid_until.description: Date the TC card stops being valid. After this, the dispatcher stops the automation (see `internal/queries/automations_to_run.py`). Null = no expiry. Distinct from `end_date` (top-level automation stop date) — they can differ. Persists as `config.VALID_UNTIL` in MM/DD/YYYY format (legacy).

message.title: Message
message.description: TC card message text shown to the creator (max 500 chars). Different from `messages[]` (initial outreach DM addons) — this is the body on the invitation card itself. The portal rejects bodies containing the word `amazon`. Persists as `config.TARGET_COLLAB_MESSAGE`.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: Content type preference for this TC. Translates to the legacy DB enum (`No preference` / `Shoppable video` / `Shoppable LIVE`) at the persistence boundary.

support_contact.description: Brand-side support contact shown on the TC card. Optional ONLY when this shop has a default configured via `PUT /public/v1/target-collabs/support-contact-default` (CORE-5428) — in that case it's used as the fallback. When provided here it overrides the shop default for this request. If neither is present the request is rejected with 422 `SUPPORT_CONTACT_REQUIRED` (the portal also rejects TC creates without a contact email).

TargetCollabConfig.title: TargetCollabConfig
TargetCollabConfig.description:
TC-specific config — invitation metadata, commission rates, sample
policy, content type, support contact. Maps to the legacy TC config
blob shape (UPPERCASE root keys: BASE_INVITATION_NAME, VALID_UNTIL,
TARGET_COLLAB_MESSAGE, EMAIL, PHONE_NUMBER, OFFER_FREE_SAMPLES,
AUTO_APPROVE, PRODUCTS) — the worker reads from those, so the
translator flattens this nested model accordingly.

email.title: Email
email.description: Contact email shown to the creator on the TC card.

TargetCollabContact.title: TargetCollabContact
TargetCollabContact.description:
Brand-side contact info displayed on the TC card so the creator
can reach the merchant with questions. `email` is required by the
portal at TC create time; `phone` is optional. Persists at the legacy
config root as `EMAIL` / `PHONE_NUMBER`.

creator_handle.title: Creator Handle
creator_handle.description: TikTok @-handle (without the `@`). Resolved server-side against this shop's CRM / affiliate list (a row in ``crm_creators`` for ``reacher_shop_id=<shop_id>`` whose ``creator_name`` matches the handle, ordered by GMV via a LEFT JOIN against the region's creator table). The creator must already have interacted with your shop — handles for creators who haven't applied / sampled / transacted yet will not resolve, even if the handle exists globally on TikTok. Unknown handle → 404 ``CREATOR_NOT_FOUND``.

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: TikTok Shop product ID to attach to the invitation.

shop_ads_commission_rate.title: Shop Ads Commission Rate
shop_ads_commission_rate.description: Optional Shop Ads (co-funded) commission rate (0.0-1.0). When set, persists into the legacy PRODUCTS blob at the per-product level; the TC runtime fills the matching field on the TC form. Omit to leave unset (worker treats as not configured).

message.title: Message
message.description: TC card message body shown to the creator (max 500 chars). Mirrors `target_collab.message` on the full TC create surface — the portal rejects bodies containing the word `amazon`.

invitation_name.title: Invitation Name
invitation_name.description: Name shown on the TC invitation card (max 30 chars). Same field as `target_collab.invitation_name` on the full TC create.

valid_until.title: Valid Until
valid_until.description: Date the TC card stops being valid. Defaults to today + 30 days when omitted. After this date the dispatcher stops the underlying automation (see `internal/queries/automations_to_run.py`).

support_contact.description: Brand-side support contact shown on the TC card. Optional ONLY when this shop has a default configured via `PUT /public/v1/target-collabs/support-contact-default` (CORE-5428) — in that case it's used as the fallback. When provided here it overrides the shop default for this request. If neither is present the request is rejected with 422 `SUPPORT_CONTACT_REQUIRED`.

TargetCollabDirectRequest.title: TargetCollabDirectRequest
TargetCollabDirectRequest.description:
Body for POST /target-collabs — direct one-shot TC invite.

Translates internally to:
  1. AutomationTargetCollabRequest with a single-creator `list_upload`
     audience and a single-product PRODUCTS array, then
  2. create_target_collab(... created_via="api_direct"), then
  3. _transition_status("running") with audience materialization.

Returns 201 with `status: "queued"` — delivery is asynchronous via
Reacher's TC delivery worker (browser automation, same path the portal
uses). Poll GET /automations/{automation_id} for delivery status.

status.title: Status
status.description: Always `queued` on success. The underlying automation is `running` immediately; the field name reflects delivery semantics (the TC invite itself is queued for the worker).

creator_id.title: Creator Id
creator_id.description: Resolved creator_id for the supplied handle.

creator_handle.title: Creator Handle
creator_handle.description: The handle echoed back (stripped of any leading `@`).

shop_id.title: Shop Id
shop_id.description: Shop the invite was created under.

check_status_at.title: Check Status At
check_status_at.description: Relative URL for polling automation state — `/public/v1/automations/{automation_id}`.

queued_at.title: Queued At
queued_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the start transition fired.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: True when X-Dry-Run was set — no automation row was created and no worker job was queued. `automation_id` is `0` and `queued_at` reflects the request time.

TargetCollabDirectResponse.title: TargetCollabDirectResponse
TargetCollabDirectResponse.description:
201 envelope for POST /target-collabs.

Queued-semantics surface — the POST returns immediately after persisting
the underlying automation row and flipping it to `running`. Actual TC
delivery happens asynchronously via the tc_v5 worker (browser
automation). Poll GET /automations/{automation_id} for delivery status.

email.title: Email
email.description: Contact email shown to the creator on the TC card.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: E.164 format recommended. Normalized at persistence.

TargetCollabDirectSupportContact.title: TargetCollabDirectSupportContact
TargetCollabDirectSupportContact.description:
Brand-side support contact shown on the TC invitation card. Mirrors
`TargetCollabContact` exactly — kept as a separate class so the direct
surface's OpenAPI doesn't pull in the heavier automation-shape model
name when callers only see this endpoint.

TargetCollabPatchPayload.title: TargetCollabPatchPayload
TargetCollabPatchPayload.description:
All-Optional companion to `TargetCollabConfig` for PATCH bodies.
`extra="forbid"` rejects typos so a PATCH like `{invitatoin_name:
"..."}` returns 422 instead of silently no-op'ing.

shop_ads_commission_rate.title: Shop Ads Commission Rate
shop_ads_commission_rate.description: Optional Shop Ads (co-funded) commission rate (0.0-1.0). Persisted into the legacy PRODUCTS blob; the TC runtime fills it on the TC form when present.

auto_approve.title: Auto Approve
auto_approve.description: When true, accepted invites trigger immediate sample-request auto-approval without manual review. Maps to top-level `config.AUTO_APPROVE`. Per architecture review 2026-05-01.

TargetCollabSamplePolicy.title: TargetCollabSamplePolicy
TargetCollabSamplePolicy.description:
TC sample policy. Three modes from the portal:

  1. Manual approval                — `offer_free_samples=False, auto_approve=False`
  2. Free samples + manual approval — `offer_free_samples=True,  auto_approve=False`
  3. Free samples + auto approval   — `offer_free_samples=True,  auto_approve=True`

`offer_free_samples=False, auto_approve=True` is also accepted but
rare in prod (~0% — see audit 2026-05-01).

TargetMetricsInput.title: TargetMetricsInput
TargetMetricsInput.description: Nested model for target metrics in request payloads

TargetMetricsResponse.title: TargetMetricsResponse
TargetMetricsResponse.description: Nested model for target metrics in response payloads

TargetResponse.title: TargetResponse
TargetResponse.description: Response model for a single target

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: Up to 10 target sets, one per granularity. Repeating a granularity is rejected.

TargetsBulkWriteRequest.title: TargetsBulkWriteRequest
TargetsBulkWriteRequest.description: Several granularities' goals in one call.

results.title: Results
results.description: One entry per submitted target set, in request order.

TargetsBulkWriteResponse.title: TargetsBulkWriteResponse
TargetsBulkWriteResponse.description: Per-granularity results of a bulk target write.

granularity.description: Period the goals apply to: weekly, monthly or quarterly.

targets.description: Per-metric goal values. Omit a metric to leave it unset; at least one must be provided.

effective_from.title: Effective From
effective_from.description: When the goals start applying. Defaults to now. Cannot be more than a year in the future.

created.title: Created
created.description: True when no target existed for this granularity and a new one was created; false when an existing one was updated.

TargetsWriteResponse.title: TargetsWriteResponse
TargetsWriteResponse.description: Result of a single-granularity target write.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: L0-L7, by the creator's ALL-TIME platform GMV.

creators.title: Creators
creators.description: Creators of this tier with any funnel activity in the week.

touches.title: Touches
touches.description: Outreach messages sent — three DMs to one creator counts three. Use `reached` for distinct creators.

gmv.title: Gmv
gmv.description: GMV attributed to the window, not the lifetime GMV that set the tier.

TierFunnelRow.title: TierFunnelRow
TierFunnelRow.description: One GMV tier's outreach funnel inside a week.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Inclusive window start (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 8 weeks back.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Inclusive window end (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to yesterday.

weeks.title: Weeks
weeks.description: One entry per week touching the window, quiet weeks included.

conversion_rate.title: Conversion Rate
conversion_rate.description: Recomputed from the week's totals, not averaged across the eight tiers — that would weight an L7 with one creator like an L0 with two thousand.

TierTotal.title: TierTotal
TierTotal.description: Every tier in the week, summed.

week_start.title: Week Start
week_start.description: The Sunday the week starts on (YYYY-MM-DD).

week_ending.title: Week Ending
week_ending.description: The Saturday it ends on — the label reports use ('WE 9/12').

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.description: L7 down to L0; all eight always present.

shops_queried.title: Shops Queried
shops_queried.description: Shop names included when querying multiple shops (x-shop-id: all or comma-separated).

TrackerVideosRequest.description:

creator-campaign mapping's posted videos (used by the settlement
screen on the portal).

posted_at_epoch.title: Posted At Epoch
posted_at_epoch.description: Unix timestamp TikTok reports for the video's creation.

rank_change.title: Rank Change
rank_change.description: Positions gained (+) or lost (-) since the previous ranking.

views_min.title: Views Min
views_min.description: TikTok reports views as a bucket, not an exact count.

video_ids.title: Video Ids
video_ids.description: Export these specific videos. Filters below are then ignored.

format.title: Format

TrendingVideosExportBody.title: TrendingVideosExportBody
TrendingVideosExportBody.description:

``shop_id``: on the public API the shop comes from the ``x-shop-id`` header,
and accepting a second, ignorable copy in the body would let a caller
believe they had scoped an export that they had not.

When ``video_ids`` is non-empty the filter fields are ignored and exactly
those videos are exported; otherwise the export covers the current
filter + sort, capped server-side.

WriteErrorResponse.title: WriteErrorResponse
WriteErrorResponse.description:
Documented error envelope for write-endpoint failures.

`error.code` values customers should expect:
  - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED   400 — POST/DELETE without the header
  - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_TOO_LONG   400 — header > 255 chars
  - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED     409 — same key, different body
  - IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_FLIGHT  409 — same key, prior call still running
  - INVALID_REQUEST            400 — Pydantic validation or forbidden fields
  - WRITE_NOT_PERMITTED        403 — api_key lacks 'read_write' scope
  - WRITE_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED  429 — write tier exceeded
  - AUTOMATION_ARCHIVED        409 — operation blocked, row is archived
  - NOT_FOUND                  404 — automation_id not in this shop

ShopId.name: x-shop-id
ShopId.description: The shop ID to query. Accepts a single integer, a comma-separated list of integers (e.g. '101,202,303'), or 'all' to query every shop your API key has access to. Multi-shop responses include a 'shops_queried' field and use USD as the default currency. Detail endpoints (e.g. GET /creators/{handle}, GET /automations/{id}) require a single shop ID. On the brand-agnostic AI Search and Social Intelligence endpoints, an agency key may pass 'all' for cross-brand discovery together with an owned 'anchor_shop' query param, whose region is the search market; every shop the key reaches is still limited to its own account.

tags.description: Internal-only creator sample-review intelligence: a creator's recent videos with AI creative analysis, per-video metrics, and the creator aggregate a reviewer weighs before approving a sample request. Access restricted to internal Reacher staff keys; not available to customer API keys.

tags.name: Automations
tags.description: Automation performance and outreach metrics. Email automations are a separate kind with their own read + lifecycle routes under /automations/email (they are not returned by POST /automations/list).

tags.name: Email Accounts
tags.description: Connected inboxes available to back email automations. Read-only; access tokens are never exposed.

tags.name: Personalization
tags.description: AI-personalized outreach (CORE-4857): preview the message a creator would receive, resolve product blocks, retone copy, and read fallback stats + per-creator sent history. Configure it on a DM via the `personalization` block of POST /automations/dm. Single-shop only.

tags.name: Target Collabs
tags.description: Send a single TikTok Shop Target Collab invitation to one creator by handle — convenience surface over the two-step automation create + start. For >10 invites at a time, use POST /automations/target-collab with a multi-creator audience instead. Also exposes GET/PUT /target-collabs/support-contact-default to configure a shop-level default `support_contact`, which the TC create surfaces fall back to when a request omits it.

tags.name: Metrics
tags.description: Time-series metrics for dashboards and charts.

tags.name: Shop GMV
tags.description: Full TikTok Seller Center shop GMV (ads + organic + affiliate) — daily series and window totals with channel breakdown. Distinct from POST /metrics/timeseries metric=gmv, which is affiliate-attributed only.

tags.name: Shop Health
tags.description: Per-shop TikTok Shop Performance Score (SPS) and its health sub-metrics (on-time dispatch, negative-review rate, etc.) — daily trend and latest snapshot. Sourced from TikTok's official shop_performances API.

tags.name: P&L
tags.description: Merchant profit & loss straight from your TikTok Seller Center finance export: window totals as an ordered waterfall, the running P&L bucketed by day / week / bi-weekly / month, and order x SKU detail with its fee breakdown. Every figure is TikTok's own, summed and never recomputed, so any cadence reconciles to Seller Center exactly. Rows are bucketed by order PAID date in the shop's Seller Center timezone, so recent windows keep moving as orders settle — read ``data_status`` on every response for freshness. Costs TikTok cannot see are supplied separately: store cost of goods per SKU and per-unit sample cost with ``PUT /pnl/costs``, then read ``POST /pnl/profit`` for the contribution profit they imply. ``POST /pnl/skus`` rolls the same figures up per SKU as a gross / contribution P&L (revenue and per-SKU fees less cost of goods); per-SKU ad spend is not available, so the true net bottom line stays on the summary and profit surfaces. Single-shop only, and enabled per shop on request.

tags.name: Finance
tags.description: TikTok's settlement side of the books, from the Finance API: daily settlement statements (what was settled, what fees and adjustments were taken, whether the payout is PAID, PROCESSING or FAILED), the line items of each statement with their full fee and tax breakdown, and payouts to the bank before and after currency exchange. Windowed by settlement date (UTC), unlike the P&L which is by order paid date; a settled P&L order row carries ``linked_statement_id`` to join the two. Data is synced daily and available from 2023-07-01. Single-shop only, and the shop's TikTok authorization must include the finance scope — otherwise every call returns ``403 SCOPE_NOT_GRANTED`` with a re-authorize link. Read ``data_status`` on every response.

tags.name: Affiliate Orders
tags.description: Affiliate Center -> Orders, over the API: one row per order x SKU with the creator, the content (video / LIVE / showcase) that drove the sale, the commission model and rates, and estimated vs actual commission side by side. This is the order-level audit trail behind ``/creators/performance`` and ``/videos/performance``. Rows are keyed on TikTok's seller and bucketed by order CREATED date in the shop's Affiliate Center timezone; status and actual amounts keep moving for weeks as commission settles, so read ``data_status`` for freshness. Single-shop only. A shop whose export collection is not yet enabled reads ``data_status.state == "not_enabled"`` with a ``data_status.detail`` explaining it — an empty page is far more often that than a shop with no affiliate sales.

tags.name: Lives
tags.description: Creator LIVE-attributed GMV — window totals and per-session rows from TikTok's Affiliate Center LIVE data. Distinct from the ``gmv`` field (all affiliate revenue); the same number is on POST /metrics/* as ``live_gmv``. Single-shop, currency-aware.

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Affiliate funnel and creator level distributions.

tags.name: GMV Max
tags.description: TikTok Smart+ (GMV Max) campaigns and daily performance metrics for your shop.

tags.name: Meta Ads
tags.description: Cross-channel Meta Ads rev-share campaigns: campaign settings + creator roster, the per-campaign leaderboard (attributed GMV, ad spend, impressions, commission from the attribution ledger), Stripe creator payouts + history, and the Meta media library. All money is reported in cents in the shop's Meta ad account currency. Single shop only. Distinct from GMV Max (TikTok Smart+ ads) and from Creator Community campaign payments at /campaigns/payments/*.

tags.name: AI Search
tags.description: Multi-modal creator search backed by the same retrieval pipeline as the portal: profile (natural-language), transcript (spoken-word), video (visual), and lookalike (creator->creator). GET /ai-search/capabilities reports which modes the shop's region supports; transcript/video/lookalike auto-enable per region as their indexes backfill. CSV export (profile results) has a 50,000-row hard cap. Normally requires a single x-shop-id (the shop's region is the search context); an agency key (agency_read scope) may instead search across all its brands at once with x-shop-id: all plus an owned `anchor_shop` query param, whose region is the search market — the shop-scoped `shop_gmv` field is then omitted. CSV export stays single-shop.

tags.name: Creator Messages
tags.description: Read the shop's creator DM inbox (conversation list + per-conversation message threads, both paginated), read inbox unread/unreplied stats, and reply to creators programmatically (e.g. from an AI agent). Replies require the read_write scope and only work in conversations a creator has already opened.

tags.name: Campaigns
tags.description: Create and manage Creator Community Campaigns — Retainer, Challenge, Leaderboard, and Live GMV Challenge types. Full surface: CRUD, creator accept/reject/reactivate/remove, cross-shop add-to-campaign (move) with region + same-customer guards, content tracking, request-more-content, deposit-intent + settlement with full idempotency + dry-run + audit logging on the money-moving path.

tags.name: Social Intelligence
tags.description: Market intelligence across the TikTok Shop ecosystem — sellers, products, creators, videos, benchmarks. These endpoints require Social Intelligence access to be enabled for your account — contact Reacher to request access. The reads normally require a single x-shop-id (to pick the region and mark your own brand); an agency key (agency_read scope) sending x-shop-id: all may instead name an owned `anchor_shop` query param, which is used as the request's single shop — you get the same ecosystem-wide data, anchored to that owned brand's region and self-markers.

tags.name: Discord
tags.description: Post to your connected Discord server — list channels, post a message now, schedule one or a recurring (e.g. weekly) series, and read back scheduled / sent messages with their engagement. Requires a connected Discord integration; posting needs a `read_write` key. Supports text, a bold title, mentions, and base64 image / file attachments.
